items.d:
Ore found in Raktehelm Volcano's lava flows.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the power of fire due to the lava's intense heat.
"I went discovered this miraculous ore when I was surveying Agnara Volcano. The primordial power emanating from this ore was incomparable to any other ore I had encountered before."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 1
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Ore found in Raktehelm Snowdrift Mountain.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the coldness of snow.
"As I continued my research, I found this ore, which holds trace amounts of magical energy. It shares the same properties as the other ores I have been researching."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 2
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Ore found in the limestone cave in Raktehelm's forest.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the strength of the forest.
"These unique ores must have absorbed magic from the surrounding area. Changes can be seen not only in the colour of the ore, but in its ability to influence things of the same element."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 3
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Ore found in Raktehelm's Ruins.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the power of Light due to being bathed in it in the ruins.
"With the discovery of this Light Ore, I have determined two ways these ores come to possess elemental power. One way is to be exposed to powerful elemental power, and the other is to be exposed to the same elemental power over a long period of time."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 4
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Ore found in Raktehelm's Magic Cave.
An ore created by the mixing of a corpse with magical energy, which was then imbued with the power of dark, due to lying in the darkness for a long time.
"Further research has made it possible to use the power hidden in these ores without breaking them. This will allow us to create new items which couldn't be made before.
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 5
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Crystals found in the caverns of Raktehelm's Volcano.
Fire Crystals are supposedly created when Fire Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"This crystal amazed me. We already have the technology to create crystals artificially, but these natural crystals hold far greater power than our artificial ones. Human ingenuity still lags far behind the forces of nature."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 1
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Crystals found in Raktehelm Snowdrift Mountain.
Water Crystals are supposedly created when Water Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"I have realized that with these crystals, we can make even more powerful items than before. Soldiers and people from magic organizations from other countries have started visiting me..."
Archam Waiver, from "The Power Hidden Within Ores" Chapter 2
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Crystals found in the limestone cave in Raktehelm's forest
Earth Crystals are supposedly created when Earth Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"The military has begun funding my research, and although thanks to their funding, I have been able to create higher quality crystals, I have started having doubts about what I'm doing."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 3
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Crystals found in Raktehelm's Ruins.
Light Crystals are supposedly created when Light Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"I could not allow my research to be used for slaughter any longer. I secretly prepared a way to escape from the military. My humanity is more important to me than my research."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 4
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
Crystals found in Raktehelm's Magic Cave.
Dark Crystals are supposedly created when Dark Ore has exceptionally pure magical energy and crystalizes over time.
"I took my research and escaped after making this discovery. It wasn't easy, but I'll won't mention any details in this book, since doing so may inconvenience the people who helped me."
Archam Waiver, from "Crystals To Adore" Chapter 5
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of raging fire.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over this volcano. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"I escaped from my country and asked a temple to shelter me. They didn't pressure me to make weapons for them, and I came to trust them."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 1
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of extreme cold.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over this glacier. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"Doing my research under the protection of the temple has had unexpected benefits. I was given the opportunity to touch the immensely powerful Spirit Stone the temple keeps locked away as a divine miracle."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 2
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of steadfast trees.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over the depths of nature. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"I have deduced that the Spirit Stones are made from highly purified crystals of their own element. Each stone constantly emits a remarkably large amount of energy, which has given me some new ideas."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 3
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of light.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over these ruins. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"I petitioned the temple to let me study their Spirit Stone, and they accepted. The results of my research were very promising, and I have decided to spread the word, so the whole world can benefit.
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 4
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d:
A Spirit Stone containing the power of darkness.
The exact details are unknown, but it's said that a god once ruled over these ruins. Its body becoming mixed into these crystals caused them to change.
"Unfortunately, its power will be used by the military in the end. As sickness comes to claim me, I have only one wish. I hope my research will benefit everyone somehow."
Archam Waiver, from "The Mystery Of Spirit Stones" Chapter 5
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Hide from Moo beasts which have extremely thick skin. Because of its toughness, Moo hide is used to make a wide range of high quality, durable products, from bags and pouches to boots, gloves and armour. Moos have been successfully domesticated. Most are bred in Raktehelm's South Bamint farmlands.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: This wand was created towards the end of the great war, with wood from the old oak forest in what is now Northwest La Riiz. The old oak forest was destroyed during the war, making it impossible to create any new wands. The wood the wand is made from is sturdy and has a strong affinity for magical and supernatural energies, which makes it a great base for creating magical items. Due to its rarity and many uses, however, thieves, archaeologists and weapons merchants are all fighting for it.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: A fang taken from a monster. It holds great magical power and can be used as a medium for spells. If it bites into an enemy, it won't let go, so it also has its uses for Capture magic and items. These properties are useful not only for mages, but also for knights. There is a recent trend, where people send a fang to a lover to "grab hold of their heart", and many knights have rushed to defeat monsters to get one.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: A material used for making magical items. It is a liquid originally, but solidifies when mixed with a catalyst. In its solid state, it causes the effects of substances it is mixed with to diffuse into their surroundings, and can even be used to create an antidotal mist against poisons. Due to its versatility, people call daily for new compounds of the gem to be made, but so far no one has succeeded.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: The most widely-sold metal in Raktehelm is Miram Steel. Isliid has the most abundant deposits of the metal in Raktehelm. It is easily processed, relatively resilient and very easy to come by, so it is used for everything from weapons and armour, to building materials and cooking utensils. However, although it is strong against physical attacks, it has zero magical resistance, so one must bear that in mind when using it as armour.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: This stone was supposedly taken from the Sea of Stars. Its name is "White Knight", Guardian of the South, Governor of the Dawn. According to the Spirits' legends, aeons ago, a knight bearing the Star Stone rescued the Sun God from the Underworld, and brought light back to the world. The Spirits recite this legend whenever there is an eclipse. A Star Stone was recently discovered in the shrine of some corrupted Spirits, and a historical study of the stones has been started.

A rare crystal which can only be found in a handful of places in Raktehelm. The crystal appears to contain the essence of flames, and is also known as "The Everlasting Flame". This mysterious crystal has the ability to raise its own heat in response to the strength of its user's fighting spirit. Even the most skilled technicians have trouble handling it, so there are only a few weapons in the world which use this crystal.
src: Pride of the Warrior > [EX1] Pride of the Warrior
Pride of the Warrior > [EX2] Feast of the Warrior
Pride of the Warrior > [SPEX] Rhapsody of the Warrior

items.d: An arcane metal rarely found in Raktehelm. It is filled with the power of Light, and shines incandescently. It is often used as a material for weapons, and has a beauty that rivals that of gold. Because of this, in the past, it caused massive inflation in market prices, and selling the metal is now forbidden without a permit. The Guild still keeps a close eye on the material and few are willing to cross them.

This rare seed is said to bring good fortune to its bearer. The flower only grows at high altitudes and because of their rarity, they fetch a high price. A man looking for this seed eventually found a flower blooming in a Light Bird's nest. Overjoyed, he reached in to grab it, but in the same instant, he lost his footing. The man fell a great distance, but was miraculously unharmed. He was deeply disappointed, however, because the Lindrum seed he had only just obtained had used up all of its luck to save him.

From ancient times, this guiding stone is said to lead a chosen one. The light of this stone opens up the bearer's soul to awaken its true power. The stone that appeared before Liese when he started his adventure in this mysterious world, was Heliolite, which embodies "Exploration". Along with a will, which shines like the Sun, Liese forges ahead with his adventure into the unknown. His discoveries may soon make all of our history books redundant.
src: Side Story Dungeon > Patrol the Plain
Side Story Dungeon > An Unexpected Visitor
Side Story Dungeon > An Unsettling Image

items.d: This guiding stone possesses the ability to draw out the power hidden deep within a person. Over the course of her travels with her friends, this girl, who carries a unique burden has started to gain the will to live as an individual. The hidden power of this stone responds to her innocent and pure desire to protect her loved ones, and the light the Moonstone emits will cultivate limitless potential within her, and become a light to guide her along the right path.
src: Iris' Side Dungeon First Half > A Frantic Morning
Iris' Side Dungeon First Half > Follow Liese
Iris' Side Dungeon First Half > At the Fire Mountaincat
Iris' Side Dungeon First Half > Sensitive Iris
Iris' Side Dungeon First Half > What Iris Found!
Iris' Side Dungeon First Half > Curiosity Killed the Cat
Iris' Side Dungeon Second Half > Head in the Clouds
Iris' Side Dungeon Second Half > About Tiny Things
Iris' Side Dungeon Second Half > To Protect, to be Protected

items.d: This guiding stone is a catalyst, which draws out the power of humans' strength of will. Almadin responds to the "Pride" of those who bear this stone, and helps them to realize their true potential. Ganan's pride, which was hurt after long years of being bound by his regret for his past mistakes was restored to its former youthful state, and the stone regained its light. Just as warriors of the past surpassed their own limits with this stone, Ganan's legend is sure to continue as well.
src: Pride of the Warrior > [EX1] Pride of the Warrior
Pride of the Warrior > [EX2] Feast of the Warrior

items.d: This guiding stone releases the emotions buried deep within a person. In the past, a former female knight, who, fearful of her failings, bound herself in self control, became a receptionist in the arena. However, out of respect for her father, who was also a knight, and through her own encounters with adventurers, she came to realize that she could never cast her pride aside. When she saw herself for who she truly was, and chose release over suppression, she found her true strength.

This guiding stone has the ability to change human emotions into power. A female chef once found hope in an adventurer who looked very much like her father, a man who was her mentor, and her ideal man. In order to guide the man with his promising future and to take him to higher heights, she hung this stone about her neck. The power of this stone will, no doubt, make you stronger and stronger, and allow you to reach the pinnacle of cooking and gathering ingredients.
src: The Master Chef's Test > 【EX1】The Master Chef's Test
The Master Chef's Test > 【EX2】Sophie's Teaching Tool

items.d: This crystal was supposedly made by the Reaper himself, in order to create his own family. Anyone who holds this sinisterly glowing crystal is tormented by the Reaper's voice and their soul will eventually be dominated by him. During the great war, the demon who stole this crystal from a lesser Reaper was driven insane and began slaughtering people indiscriminately. Eventually, the demon was hunted down by his own kind for his deeds, and was buried together with the crystal. This particular crystal has never existed in the world since then.
src: Shrine of Remembrance > Shrine of Remembrance【AWK】

items.d: Created by The Divine Princess, Ladoakune, who has borne and raised many children, this crystal brings children into their own power. Although it has great magical power, it is also surrounded by the miasma of the Underworld, so it can be harmful to the children of Raktehelm. Before the great war, the land this crystal was seen in was said to be overcome by corruption, and eventually consumed by death. This crystal is indeed dangerous, but there are apparently many people who seek it for its power.
src: Sanctuary of the Divine Princess > Sanctuary of the Princess【AWK】

items.d: Occasionally found in Raktehelm, this crystal contains magical power. It is said that the changes are due to the magic stone being bathed in the power of fire for a long time. In the Isliid Empire, where there are many blacksmiths, being able to work this material is proof that you are ready to become independent. Thus, an apprentice whose ability has been acknowledged forges this magic stone into a sword in front of his teacher. This is called The Inheritance Ceremony Of Fire, a rite that has been passed down by blacksmiths since ancient times.

A crystal overflowing with the power of water. Quenching with this material leaves a beautiful pattern on the blade, but it is also incredibly difficult to use. Because even the slightest change in temperature can be enough to cause it to break, the blacksmith must be knowledgeable about alchemy and magic to make a prototype. Because of this, when the crystal was first discovered, many blacksmiths became apprentices to alchemists and mages.
src: Battle against the Silent Holy Knight

items.d: Amber that is occasionally found in Raktehelm. While this material is used as a processing material, it sometimes also has academic value. Although rare, there have been cases of ancient plants and animals found encased in Amber. These specimens give us clues about the ecosystem thousands of years ago. But to the blacksmith, such things are irrelevant, so they quickly get crushed beneath his hammer. The screams of archaeologists are quite audible in the smithing town.
src: Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird

items.d: A rare crystal that holds the power of light. It has the ability to gather and release the elements in the atmosphere. During the great war, the Magus Empire of La Riiz tested this crystal's possible military applications, and prototypes were eventually sent to the battlefield. It is said that the crystals bursting with magical power were released and the enemy burned, but all of the Magus Empire's frontline soldiers were killed, too. Since then, the magic research laboratory has kept one Yellow Thunder Crystal to remind them of their folly.

A jet-black crystal occasionally found in Raktehelm. It can enhance the properties of a material when used during weapon processing. In the past, a blacksmith used the crystal with some scrap metal, and made a sword with a jet-black blade. It was just for fun really, but surprisingly, a number of people absolutely loved it. Afterwards, there were apparently a large number of self-proclaimed "pitch black swordsmen enthralled by the darkness".

A Magic Stone inscribed with an ancient rune.
It contains the power of fire, and is thought to have been created by the Gods. Even a slight bump or application of heat can cause the stone to ignite, so care must be taken when carrying it. It has been a useful enhancement material since ancient times, but because of its temperament, fires are not uncommon. Because of this, in the Isliid Empire, it is now customary to have an alchemist's atelier in the workshop that handle Magic Stones.

A Magic Stone thought to have been created by the Gods. Ancient runes are inscribed on the stone. It contains the power of ice. Because it constantly emanates cold air, it can be used not only as a material for processing armour, but also as a coolant. This rare Magic Stone is apparently set out in the town square Gramenia Republic to cool the populace. While the people of the Republic are quite pleased by this, some criticise it, saying it's just a political performance.
src: Battle against the Silent Holy Knight

items.d: A Magic Stone found in Raktehelm. Ancient runes meaning "Earth" are inscribed on the stone. It contains the power of Earth. It is currently used as a material for processing weapons, but its origins are still unknown. An adventurer discovered the stone deep within the decayed Ancient Forest of Gonal in a shrine to the Spirits. Because of this, we know that the Magic Stone was created before the era preceding the great war.
src: Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird

items.d: A Magical Stone that was created in ancient times. A rune meaning "Sky" is inscribed on the stone. It contains the power of light. Because it is constantly charged by the elements, it is dangerous to touch it with your bare hands. In the past, some on the Beast tribes used these stones for hunting by throwing them into rivers and simply taking the fish that floated to the surface. Now, however, it seems their pride dictates that they hunt using their own strength.

A rune meaning "Night" is inscribed on this Magic Stone. It contains the power of dark, but this alone would give it no abilities. However, rumour has it that its mysterious beauty drives people insane. In fact, there is a story of an empress, who enthralled by the stone, went insane and began a reign of terror. Even an expert blacksmith will refuse to handle this Magic Stone after sunset.

A crystal said to be expelled from the divine Fire Dragon Deglumagna's mouth when it roars. Since the dragon only emerges once every few hundred years, there are very few of these rare crystals. Additionally, Petra, one of Isliid's greatest adventurers writes: "The bearer of this gem will gain mighty power, but that power will also bring him great ruin."
src: The Crimson King > The Crimson King【AWK】

items.d: This crystal is also called "Brilliant Dragon, Fos Radius". Because it glows so brightly, all other gems look dull in comparison, it is highly sought after by adventurers and thieves. However, it is said that anyone touching this gem will cause the Light Dragon to rain down destruction on the world. The dragon has been enraged for many years after the crystal's theft, but the truth of the matter is somewhat different. The crystal, in fact, controls a seal the dragon put on itself because it abhors its own destructive power.

Every so often, there are individuals within the Valzandes who are blessed with exceptional latent ability and extraordinary loyalty. It is said that they will crystalize themselves, so they can continue to help their master even after death. These crystals are known to the Demons as "Valzandes' Will", and recently discovered records show that they were stored carefully by their masters. This proves that trust and respect exist even among the Demons, but whether that trust and respect can be directed at humans is another matter entirely.
src: Caverns of Dark > Creatures of Darkness【AWK】

items.d: A rare crystal that has only been found in a handful of places in Raktehelm. It contains the soul of an Ice Wolf, a species which only inhabits lands that are absolute zero. It is said that if a person with a hesitant heart touches it, they'll be frozen in an instant. Mining for this crystal is a deadly exercise. The crystal responds only to the weapon of a user who trains tirelessly, and has a pure soul. Its hidden power, capable of guiding its user to higher heights is restricted to the chosen few.

A crystal that was discovered in multiple areas of Raktehelm at the same time. It is very valuable, because the time and location for mining this crystal cannot be determined. It emits a divine light, but the source of its glow has not been uncovered yet. Because the crystal's glow strengthens when it is close to relics said to be from another world, researchers think that this crystal could also be from another world.

A crystal which is formed inside the body of the Earth Dragon, Elpuneumas, a dragon which presides over fertility. It contains the power of life, and is said to prolong the life of its owner. The powerful magical power of this dragon may bring about death and destruction, but it also brings about life and rebirth, two sides of the same coin, if you will. It stands to reason that if you can truly control this great power, you can even overcome death.
src: The Green Strikes Back > Green Dragons of Life【AWK】

items.d: This rare crystal can only be found in certain parts of Raktehelm. It is thought to be the crystalized power of birth - or Mother Nature. Also known as "Maiden's Passion", it shines brightly when a woman holds it. This light is said to grant power to items that have been used lovingly by a woman's hand. A battlefield for women, then... It has the greatest effect on housework, in other words.
src: The Master Chef's Test > Whence the Ingredients?
The Master Chef's Test > Spores of Confusion
The Master Chef's Test > 【EX2】Sophie's Teaching Tool
The Master Chef's Test > 【SPEX】Master Chef, Sophie

items.d: A mineral that seals the power of the Specified Facility Defence Mechanism "CODE XTF", Intruder Elimination Special Model "ERASURE". This defence mechanism was created by magic, and the emotionless, merciless - one might even say, "cruel", exacting standards of the Machines. Misusing this power permits the creation of items that have "cruel" abilities, which cannot be attained by using other materials. Whether that's a good thing for the world or not, is another matter entirely.
src: Fortress of the Machine God > Death Ex Machina【AWK】

items.d: A crystal containing the power of Shangyang "Freidar". This monstrous bird is said to be the guardian of the Ice Temple. It has power over ice and snow, and according to legend, can cause a snow storm with the beating of its wings. This magic crystal steals the warmth of its surroundings just be being present, and since it is difficult for an adventurer to bring back to a safe place, this valuable material is kept within collectors' circles.
src: Cry of the Azure Roc > Blue Monster Bird【AWK】

items.d: A crystal said to be discovered once every few decades in the Principality of Bamint's rose gardens. The rose's nectar is apparently refined by the Earth's divine protection. Since ancient times, this crystal has often been found by people of noble birth. It is said that the crystal chooses who may find it. In addition, its owners have often been beautiful people, with intense personalities, and the crystal shines brightest with them. Perhaps that is why so many of its owners are female knights.
src: As a Lady > [Limited EX1] Never Ending Battle

items.d: Flame God, Ifrit left behind. An enormous amount of heat is contained within the jewel. It is possible to gently warm thousands of people if you can draw on its power effectively, but also possible to raze a country to the ground if you lose control, although it is said that the bearer would be incinerated before that happened. What reason could the Flame God possibly have had for appearing in the world and leaving this jewel here? The jewel will display its true power only to one who has asked all of the world's questions and found the answer.
src: Trials of the Flame God > The Fire God Rises【AWK】

items.d: A crystal dug up from the soil of old battlefields. The battlefields where blood and tears of warriors flow, and their regrets and accusing cries echo
src: The Demon's Pride > Return to the Demonseal Tower
The Demon's Pride > The Back of the Demon

items.d: A guiding stone that evokes only strong selfish desires. Simulacrums of a certain Demon warrior were mass produced abhorrent technology. They have the same appearance, personality and ability...but no memory. If they were to be unleashed without being given a purpose, they would eventually begin killing each other, and begin thinking, "Who are you?", "Is one of us the real one?", "Am I a fake?"... And in the end, this stone might lend its power to the sole survivor.
src: The Demon's Pride > Real x Fake
The Demon's Pride > [SPEX] Who is the "Real" One?

items.d: A crystal that can only be found in relics and weapons excavated from ancient battlefields. Old weapons not only retain the feelings of hatred and obsession of the people killed by them, but there is often a lot of residual magical power from their many battles. This crystal, which was created by these feelings and the magical power interacting, reacts to all sorts of lingering regrets, including the thoughts which collect in such objects. It is said that the more powerful the weapon, the more the crystal amplifies its power, and the brighter it shines.
src: Despair of the Ruthless Demon Armor
Despair of the Ruthless Demon Armor > 【Despair】 Atrocity of Dead Armor
Awakening Cursed Armor > Despair of the Cursed Armor【AWK】

items.d: An unusual material created when metal crystalizes as time passes. Normally, a blacksmith would forge it into all sorts of pieces of equipment, and the all of those possibilities and the expectations of the blacksmith are trapped inside this crystal. It is said to stimulate the hearts and minds of blacksmiths for this reason. The bearer of this crystal will make new discoveries in their workplace and create better weapons. They won't be able to resist swinging their hammer.
src: Legendary Blacksmith > [SPEX] Worthy of Dream Sword

items.d: A guiding stone that leads its bearer to pursue their imagination and to refine himself. The more ambitious a person's ambition is, the more they can forge ahead on their path. On the other hand, many people break reality's harsh lessons. The blacksmith never forgot his goal for a single day, but one day, he noticed that he'd been putting his work first above everything else. Then his heart will be awakened. Young adventurers and this stone made him realize.
src: Legendary Blacksmith > [EX] The Worth of Arms

items.d: The jewel of the Silent Divine, Palamicia, an ancient goddess and the world's best swordswoman. She illustrates the integrity of anyone wishing to be a swordsman, and the pride of taking that path. It is said that a swordsman who earns this jewel will know what he is aiming for, and cry of his own inexperience. Nevertheless, this jewel responds only to those who continue to aim higher and refine themselves. It will show them the way to the top, where the Holy Goddess waits.
src: Battle against the Silent Holy Knight
Battle against the Silent Holy Knight > The Dancing Silent Sword【AWK】

items.d: This is the remnants of gods powers which were scattered when the god of judgement, God of the Heavens Marzex, used his relics. Although his relic has shape, this actually is embodied from authority, so as long as it is in hands of Marzex, it will continue to gain power. Thus, even if you possess it, it wil be difficult to bring out its real powers. By using the Gem of Decision, it becomes possible to gain powers close to the God of Heavens.
src: Divine Spirit of Remembrance > Harbinger of Armageddon
Divine Spirit of Remembrance > [SPEX Hyper] Armageddon Descent

items.d: The crystalized notes of the alarm bells that the stars sound in order to protect the world from a great disaster. The ones who are influenced by this sign are the people with the potential to become saviours and heroes. This divine crystal gives them the power to fulfil their calling. Perhaps the stars will call on them to remove the imminent threat. The treasured sword of Famelle, created in ancient times is one of these, and when it begins, and it is time to guide its owner, the crystal will show itself.
src: The Fabled Sword's Chosen One > Dummy
The Fabled Sword's Chosen One > Dummy

items.d: A magical crystal that contains the fluctuations that are emitted when the rumbling of the "soul" in all things rises to the highest limit. All those who try to awaken the true strength asleep inside themselves, open the door of their soul with this crystal. However, the crystal does not react to those who don't match the requirements. The requirements are different from one person to another. It may be a strong resolution, the realization of something or resignation. The crystal shines in the hands of those who understand the conditions imposed on their own souls.

The fragment of Ifrit, the God who governs all flames and the incarnation of that power. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. Flames are the blink of life and the light of life burning highly with one's large wishes. The reason why it desented to this world might be because he wanted to choose the one with "True Flames" that can survive the trials it gives.
src: Trials of the Flame God > The Fire God Rises 【INT】
Trials of the Flame God > The Fire God Rises 【ADV】
Trials of the Flame God > The Fire God Rises 【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of Radachne, the insect princess of the underworld which left its name in the history of Demons. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. The princess is cold-hearted, and death will be difficult to avoid once you encounter it. The path to live is only given to those who can fight it off. This is not an encounter with a horrifying beast, it is a trial from the guardian of the providence of life. The will to survive improves your soul.
src: Sanctuary of the Divine Princess > Sanctuary of the Princess 【INT】
Sanctuary of the Divine Princess > Sanctuary of the Princess 【ADV】
Sanctuary of the Divine Princess > Sanctuary of the Princess 【PRO】
use: Ruler of the Six Demons Mixie

items.d: The fragment of Code XTF: Eraser which used to be a defense weapon specialized in erasing intruders created by the Machines. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. "How could a machine made by a Machine have a soul?" Those who have this question cannot find the truth. This weapon called Machine God, indeed had a soul. What is to exist? What is life? What is a soul? Finding these answers are the key.
src: Fortress of the Machine God > Death Ex Machina 【INT】
Fortress of the Machine God > Death Ex Machina 【ADV】
Fortress of the Machine God > Death Ex Machina 【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of Freydal the guardian beast of Water Temple Rog Mekia. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. The reason why Freydal has freeze abilities is because it ingests water elements in its soul. In order to truely know yourself, you must know your solid origins. To those who have overflowing springs, wide oceans, and the coldest snowfields beyond the door of their soul can hear the cry of the Blue Bird.
src: Cry of the Azure Roc > Blue Monster Bird 【INT】
Cry of the Azure Roc > Blue Monster Bird 【ADV】
Cry of the Azure Roc > Blue Monster Bird 【PRO】

items.d: A jewel left behind by the Divine Eclipse Dragon, Mavrosgia, which surpasses the very concept of "death". The Divine Eclipse Dragon does not use all of the magical power it extracts from the weapons it swallows, but instead stocks some of it. During this process, it is said that the magical power is filtered and purified somewhat. This terrible dragon reaps lives wherever it appears, but the reason its malevolence is not present in the jewel is because of its purity.
src: Shadow of the God Eater > Black Shadow of Eclipse【AWK】

items.d: A crystal occasionally found in Raktehelm, it contains  power that does not exist in any other crystal. It can raise the abilities of certain weapons. As the name suggests, many of these weapons are those that were once wielded by warriors with strong convictions. When a person who believes in himself goes on to be believed in by others, that belief eventually turns into conviction. It could be said that this is the perfect material for a warrior who walks a solitary path.

A mystical stone holding a heart of deep regret, or the desire to fix one's mistakes. We often lose that which we most value due to the lure of status, or to grand causes. Time and the past cannot be changed, but perhaps there is not call for such despair. There was once a man who broke through that flight and resolved to face up to the pain of his loss. Such is the power of love, and of guilt. Thus, this stone can guide you to that power.
src: Guardian of the Lonely Woods > 【EX】Watcher of the Ancient Forest

items.d: A crystallization of the uncertainty woven into the unseen rules that lurk behind the surface of this world. It cannot be said that everything that happens is written in the loom of destiny. There are branches and fluctuations that we call possibility, and these can influence how events unfold. Foretelling the future is a way of solidifying the path of the future. They say that imbuing tools with greater possibility improves the precision of that act.
src: Guardian of the Lonely Woods > 【AWK】A Protector's Pride

items.d: The fragment of Degilmagna, the legendary god which has been passed down from generation to generation in Raktehelm. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. Is its existence really only a disaster? Will it not be counted as a purification and regeneration of the world? So, will it be a trial or a decision? Asking the existence of the Crimson King will be mean you will be approaching the world's secrets.
src: The Crimson King > The Crimson King 【INT】
The Crimson King > The Crimson King 【ADV】
The Crimson King > The Crimson King 【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of Oldeus, the mysterious Demon God which is called "reaper." This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls.
src: Shrine of Remembrance > Shrine of Remembrance 【INT】
Shrine of Remembrance > Shrine of Remembrance 【ADV】
Shrine of Remembrance > Shrine of Remembrance 【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of Elpneumas the legendary symbol of rich harvest in Raktehelm. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. It is said that it judges Humans before it regenerates the earth through its own existence. It punishes those who forgot that with no nature, there should be no prosperity. Humans exist because earth exists. It is impossible to make this the opposite. For those who stand on earth should always keep this in mind.
src: The Green Strikes Back > Green Dragons of Life  【INT】
The Green Strikes Back > Green Dragons of Life  【ADV】
The Green Strikes Back > Green Dragons of Life  【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of Palamicia one of the knights who was highly praised. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. The inspiration of living as a swordswoman and the noble mind of praising strong warriors from other races are carved in its soul. What is true strength? If you go after this question, which Palamicia asked as well, the door will open to you.
src: Battle against the Silent Holy Knight
Battle against the Silent Holy Knight > The Dancing Silent Sword 【INT】
Battle against the Silent Holy Knight > The Dancing Silent Sword 【ADV】
Battle against the Silent Holy Knight > The Dancing Silent Sword 【PRO】

items.d: The gem that is full of violent and aggressive feelings coiled up like a snake. Although there are reasons, weapons indeed exist to hurt someone. Thus, if the owner strongly seeks to "hurt" people, it will turn into a deadly weapon. This gem will turn these into a strong and violent weapon full of curses. If you have earned the heart strong enough to fight off this, you should challenge the strength of double-edged sword.
src: The Demon's Dream > A Mysterious Beautiful Cilent
The Demon's Dream > The Lady Demon was Alive
The Demon's Dream > The Sad Life

items.d: The life stone that touches the heart of those who wish to live as their desire. There are no limits to desires and it appears in an ugly and distorted form. However, the moment it shows up on the surface of one's heart it is extremely close to purity. Cannot it be said that the soul which hurt others just didn't know how to show itself? There might have been a different future; a future where the soul took the right path and reached freedom without becoming ugly and distorted.
src: The Demon's Dream > 【EX1】A Shadow Stands in the Way

items.d: Crystals forged in the melding of minds in pursuit of strength and wisdom. Those who dare to dream traverse a lifelong path to answer, "what is power?" Infinite answers has lead to new disciplines and masteries with struggles and questions along the way. This Crystal is a beacon to those whose pursuit is lasting and pure.

Bursting from the stormclouds with thunder, Tonetaurus swooped down from the skies to leave this gem. The main source of its lightning powers come from elements secreted inside its body, which require enormous magical energy to control them. This gem's master that sealed the powers of Tonetaurus, can call forth lightning bolts from the sky. However, the best you can gain with this is rain storms. You'll need other Relics that contain Tonetaurus' powers to reveal its true powers.
src: Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird
Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird > Emerald Bird of Misfortune【AWK】

items.d: The fragment of Tonetaurus, the original God which controls the power of "thunder." This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. From ancient times, people were terrified of this disaster, thus its power could never be obtained. It continued to be the symbol of absolute power and the fuel to go after possibilities. The doors will open to those who wish and fight for powers of Gods.
src: Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird
Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird > Emerald Bird of Misfortune  【INT】
Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird > Emerald Bird of Misfortune 【ADV】
Clashing Thunder of the Emerald Bird > Emerald Bird of Misfortune 【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of Fosradius, one of the legendary dragons. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. Having both calmness and anger within, this dragon might become an encouraging ally or our worst enemy. The high-minded soul and enormous powers will draw out new possibilities and create a new light for those who wish.

The fragment of Valzandeth, a magical dragon which feels joy in obeying its master. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. This magical creature does not use its own strong powers for itself, but for its master. Although a crooked mind, it can be said that it does have loyalty. Having a unique mind, this soul fragment just might show a new way for those who challenge to fight.
src: Caverns of Dark > Creatures of Darkness  【INT】
Caverns of Dark > Creatures of Darkness  【ADV】
Caverns of Dark > Creatures of Darkness  【PRO】
use: Ruler of the Six Demons Mixie

items.d: The gold shining jewelry that influences one's sensitivity deep inside their heart. From ancient times, some people were curious whether Machines have feelings or emotions. Machines themselves do not know this answer. However, there was a Machine who changed itself by following this jewelry. By looking back to this fact, this question might be answered.

The gem that the Machines used to train themselves or to forge their weapons. The motive power of Machines is said to be "electricity," which is not magic. But this gem has powers to combine electricity and magic and is necessary for Machines to fully use magic. Thus, to secure this gem is very important and in the past countless of battles have occurred over its vein.

A gem that contains a massive amount of nature powers. The powers of Fairies and Spirits, especially the magical power mainly uses nature power and is difficult to extract. The gem has these powers, thus is possible to give great powers to Fairies and Spirits. However, it can only be found in places far away from Humans and is extremely difficult to find.

Ragsherum Phantom, the ghost born from the armor of the Demon Ragsherum. Having a deep grudge against Humans, it uses its full powers to destroy whatsoever. It is apparent in its actions that any pride his master had as a Demon has been lost. The atrocity of his true nature is in the core of its soul, and its fragment will give new power to those who seek strength.
src: Awakening Cursed Armor > Despair of the Cursed Armor 【PRO】

items.d: The remains of a portable light that used spiritual power for fuel. Since it uses spiritual powers which contains a largely unexplained creation of the forces connecting souls, death, and their attachment to the physical world, it's quite difficult to manipulate. As a result, it is incredibly rare to find techniques or items using such power. Even if this wrecked light no longer functions, it can be recycled into equipment to absorb and increase spiritual power, making it extremely useful.

The unique jewel that consists the magical powers of the Brutal Botanical Beast. It is categorized as organic minerals, in other words as Amber. It is said that the sap from the beast is crystallized when it is released outside when it is acting violently. Of course, this jewel has secret life powers of the magical plant along with magical powers, so it will be the perfect material to enhance the weapons made from it.
src: Life Draining Botanical Beast > Raging Ivy Negating Life 【AWK】

items.d: A fragment of the soul of a monster called the Brutal Botanical Beast . With its many attacks and great vitality, not to mention the murderous, hate-filled soul within, it is every bit as dangerous as the great Godbeasts of legend, despite being a mere monster. Its soul is born of pure ferocity, and gaining a piece of that power would be a great achievement for any who hold a desire for obliteration.
src: Life Draining Botanical Beast > Raging Ivy Negating Life 【PRO】

items.d: This lifestone grants protection of one who never forgot his obligations and risked his life to repay his life-debt. There was once a man who lived for loyalty alone. He obeyed orders despite the risk to his own life, and eventually, the danger caught up to him. When he saw the noble spirit of the one who saved him, he found a new reason to fight. When he opened his eyes from the path of blind obedience, this stone absorbed the honor and justice of his will.
src: Ravage of the Azure Swordsman > 【EX2】 The Azure Sword

items.d: This was once used by administrators as a measure of retainers' faith and has become crystallized through the incessant professions of loyalty. When touched by those swearing to use their strength for others, it sparkles like the surface of quiet water. However, it's true power is the ability to call forth human honesty. Whoever holds it is driven toward goodness and proclamations of justice. If the one bearing it was always a warrior for right, it may offer power never before seen!Gem of Faith

The permanently frozen gem that the frozen overlord "Aerugraxes" leaves behind. The dragon's biology makes it uniquely capable of exhaling subzero breath, its center nesting an icy core that never melts. The dragon is said to harness this magical energy that is impossible in the natural world by extracting and resonating its energy patterns to increase its potency many times over.
src: A Subzero Hellscape > Frozen Dragon of Doom 【AWK】

items.d: The ice dragon Aerugraxes has long been feared in Raktehelm, for it can lay waste to the whole world. Whether this tale is a warning to all the races, or some kind of test, is known only within the great Dragon's soul. This fragment of the Ice Dragon's lonely soul, whose mere touch can turn all to ice, can offer not only great magical power to those seeking to be alone, but also perhaps offer a path to another life.
src: A Subzero Hellscape > Frozen Dragon of Doom 【INT】
A Subzero Hellscape > Frozen Dragon of Doom 【ADV】
A Subzero Hellscape > Frozen Dragon of Doom 【PRO】

items.d: The fragment of the Hadean Dragon Mavroskia, the one who calls for disasters. This will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. A cruel fate awaits the ones the dragon shows itself. Despite the despair in front of them, to those who have the will to go forward will find their true powers once they get this fragment. To eliminate the darkness or to become darkness is entirely up to them...
src: Shadow of the God Eater > Black Shadow of Eclipse 【INT】
Shadow of the God Eater > Black Shadow of Eclipse 【ADV】
Shadow of the God Eater > Black Shadow of Eclipse 【PRO】

items.d: Ragsherum, commander of the six great Demon Generals, awoke to lead Rakthelm into deep fear. Regarding "Humans" as the inferior race, Ragsherum questioned why they won the Ancient War. While he appeared calm and almost cautious of Humans, he burned with anger, vowing to avenge his humiliated Master. Cursing lowly Humans, his soul is full of hatred and its fragment conceals enormous dark powers of his grudge.
src: My Will, My Rage > The Masterless Dragon

items.d:
Knight of Light Feena, one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, wore this veil. Though a mere Human, she was granted permission to serve in the Divine Army, and she typically hid her mortal countenance from view with this veil. Though she devoted herself to healing the ravages of war,
she never felt worthy of the praise she was given. She responded only with humility to those calling her Holy Mother. It's likely that this veil, bathed as it was in her overflowing spirit and the unending praise she received, will resonate with the other equipment she used.
src: The Twin Knights of the Morning Star
use: Sealed Tome "Truth of the Morning Star"

items.d: A crystal left behind by Ice Fortress Geo Zagnus, Giant of Absolute Zero, an unstoppable force of destruction that lays waste to all it sees. Long ago he was merely called Ice Fastness, but he continued to grow and soon he was able to change cold into magical power, increasing his destructive abilities. This treasure is a crystallization of that power, and if it were to encounter the Giant's arms, it could transform power from the very air and climate to give birth to a new creature of destruction.
src: Frozen Calamity in the North > Ice Fortress of Destruction 【AWK】

items.d: The Ice Fortress Geo Zagnus, who appeared from a crack in the Seals, has grown endlessly in the sub-zero wastes, and has become a creature of pure destruction. This Giant has spent ages in the frigid uninhabited lands of the pole, and as it destroyed anything that moved it has developed an absolute aversion to all that lives. The only thing its soul understands is destruction. Gaining a fragment of that soul offers the bearer overwhelming destructive power, but in exchange will transform them into a ravening beast that knows only battle.
src: Frozen Calamity in the North > Ice Fortress of Destruction 【PRO】

items.d: There are various of magic elementals, but this crystal is especially condensed with people's darkest feelings. Anyone who uses dark magic must face their inner shadows. As a result, some are entrapped and become darkness itself. But to those who use their inner shadows as their power, this crystal resonantes. If there are equipment using this power, it will bring out even more powerful magic.

This structure has survived since early in the Ancient War. No one knows its purpose, but they say it was born of the Gods and Demons together. It is clearly evidence of ways in which Light and Dark can coexist in harmony. Within this structure, Light and Dark interweave in an almost chemical reaction to create inexhaustible power. It accepts both the sacred and the profane within it, and if arms or armor are placed within, it will produce truly immense power.
src: The Five Freedom Fighters The Dawn of Raktehelm

items.d: This gem is the crystallized energy of the Flogassa, the legendary bird that burns all in its flight path like a curse that descended from the heavens. The searing magic shield that contains the entirety of its giant body is generated from the everlasting heat that emanates from inside. Compressing this energy results in this gemwhich if used to create equipment, would result in deific power that would sure to turn all it touched to ash.
src: Crimson Flames of the Phoenix > Flight of the Giant Phoenix【AWK】

items.d: It's almost more accurate to call the Crimson Flogassa, which appears from deep within the volcano, a winged sun. It raises the surrounding temperature simply by being, and the raging flames it unleashes leave only scorched earth behind. Its soul seethes like hot magma, yet when it attacks it passes in a moment. Should you gain a fragment of its power, you would have the ability to lay waste to all around you in an instant.
src: Crimson Flames of the Phoenix > Flight of the Giant Phoenix 【INT】
Crimson Flames of the Phoenix > Flight of the Giant Phoenix 【ADV】
Crimson Flames of the Phoenix > Flight of the Giant Phoenix 【PRO】

items.d: This is a gem that is condensed with the desire of all kinds people of high and pure ideology. People who lead the way are always full of hope in their hearts. It is to this belief that the gem harmonizes and reveals its true powers. This gem will guide the equipment of the ones who achieve their wishes.

A Fairy born of fire, one of the five elements which make up Raktehelm. Many of these fairies are very curious individuals, and are friendly towards humanity, the target of their curiosity. It is said that if you use the power of the purified fire contained in their bodies, it is possible to release the hidden power of the heroic spirit. However, actually meeting one of these spirits is difficult, because you would have to be an experienced adventurer who is willing to travel in the harsh volcanic and desert environments they inhabit.
src: The Path to Fire > The Path to Fire 【BGN】

items.d: A fairy born of water, one of the five elements which make up Raktehelm. Because of their bright and sociable personalities, they often come very close to the adventurers they meet. It is said that if you use the power of the purified water contained in their bodies, it is possible to release the hidden power of the heroic spirit. They are said to inhabit places with lakes and rivers. They have been spotted in the ocean, but they don't seem to like saltwater very much.
src: The Path to Water > The Path to Water 【BGN】

items.d: A fairy born of Earth, one of the five elements which make up Raktehelm. It is said that they like to live in the depths of forests. They are very laid-back, and adventurers who listen to their calm voices feel intense drowsiness. When they awaken, the Medi have disappeared, so for a long time, people thought they were illusions that the forest showed them. The purified Earth contained in their bodies makes it possible to release the hidden power of the heroic spirit.
src: The Path to Earth > The Path to Earth 【BGN】

items.d: A fairy born of Light, one of the five elements which make up Raktehelm. The purified Light contained in their bodies makes it possible to release the hidden power of the heroic spirit. They have stubborn and serious personalities, so many remain tight-lipped even after becoming friends with someone. There aren't very many adventurers who get along with Cura, apparently. In the past, the Adventurers Guild tried adding "persuading a Cura" to the entrance exam, but since even the examiner was subjected to a telling-off by the fairy, the idea was abandoned.
src: Demonseal Tower Medera > The Demonseal Tower
Demonseal Tower Medera > The Monsters of the Tower
Demonseal Tower Medera > Through the Miasma
Demonseal Tower Medera > The Guardians of the Tower
The Path to Light > The Path to Light 【BGN】

items.d: A fairy born of Dark, one of the five elements which make up Raktehelm. The purified Dark contained in their bodies makes it possible to release the hidden power of the heroic spirit. They are supposedly nocturnal, because they suddenly become very active at night, but they are also relatively energetic in caves and other dark places, so they may simply dislike bright places. They are rather cynical, and don't cooperate well with adventurers, but they are actually good fairies who happen to be passionate and caring of others.
src: The Path to Darkness > The Path to Darkness 【BGN】

items.d: This monster is called a Phantom because of its ability to appear and disappear at will. It is said that it was originally a primitive spirit without a physical form, but that it gained its current form by bonding with a strong elemental power. Having bonded with fire, Glaus' body is clad in searing flames. Because of this, people believe that whenever they see a mirage in the desert, it's because a Fire Phantom is standing inside of it. If you gain the assistance of a Phantom, the power of the heroic spirit will lead you to higher heights.
src: The Path to Fire > The Path to Fire 【INT】
The Crimson King > The Crimson King 【INT】

items.d: This monster is called a Phantom because of its ability to appear and disappear at will. It has bonded with a strong elemental power, and the power of the heroic spirit will lead you to higher heights. The Water Phantom, "River", clads itself in water droplets and travels on top of mist. Because of this, sailors in Raktehelm say that when mist covers their path, it's a "Phantom Path", and will not cross it. Even now, they will take a detour to go around it instead.
src: The Path to Water > The Path to Water 【INT】

items.d: This Phantom contains the power of Earth. Since ancient times, Medius has been said to aid people seeking love. Carrying a petal from the flower on the Phantom's tail while you walk is said to connect you with the person you love. Because of this, many young people, not just adventurers search for Medius. You might think that being chased around all the time would be annoying for a Phantom, but it seems that Medius doesn't mind, and if you do meet it, it will gladly give you a petal.
src: The Path to Earth > The Path to Earth 【INT】

items.d: This Phantom was originally a primitive spirit without a physical form, but it gained its current form by bonding with the thunder element. Because it is always riding on a cloud-like substance, it is known as the "Bringer of Thunderclouds". In the past, a rumour spread that it was easy to meet Selion on stormy days, and unfortunately, many adventurers died from being struck by lightning when they went outside equipped with their metal weapons. Because of this, the Guild has made a compulsory lesson on "Equipment Selection During Bad Weather" for new adventurers.
src: Iris' Side Dungeon Second Half > About Tiny Things
The Path to Light > The Path to Light 【INT】
Sanctuary of the Divine Princess > Sanctuary of the Princess 【INT】

items.d: This monster is called a Phantom because of its ability to appear and disappear at will. Rare even for a Phantom, Dark enjoys dark nights, and is particularly difficult to encounter. It is said to be "A Phantom of Phantoms". Furthermore, because of its slightly skewed personality, it's hard to gain its cooperation even if you do encounter one. However, because they contain the pure power of Dark, many adventurers sacrifice sleep to find Dark.
src: The Path to Darkness > The Path to Darkness 【INT】
Shrine of Remembrance > Shrine of Remembrance 【INT】

items.d: This  Spirit of the Earth which has existed for millennia in Raktehelm has changed over time. Its immense body makes it seem as if a volcano has decided to move. According to one theory, it is an entity which embodies the anger of the Earth. Legend says, all touched by Gavan's fury are burned to a cinder. The power of its raging flames are said to be capable of raising a heroic spirit to the level of a god.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: This Earth Spirit has changed over the millennia. Even the air is frozen solid in the vicinity of Bacura, a gigantic Ice Spirit, which has the ability to control water. Due to its overwhelming freezing power, some say that the Ice Spirit "Bacura" was created by God to entomb the world of Raktehelm in ice. The stark power of this gigantic Froststone is said to be capable of raising a heroic spirit to the level of a god.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: The body of this Earth Spirit is the size of an entire continent. At the end of the great war, an earthquake hit the forested area where a fierce battle was being fought in the Isliid Empire. Suddenly the ground beneath their feet lifted. They weren't aware that they were fighting on top of the Foreststone. Some soldiers were swept away and others fell into the abyss. Legend has it that after Ogole flew away, the battlefield remained silent. There were no winners that day.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: This Spirit of the Earth has been changed by the power of Light. Its immense body is enveloped in light so dazzling that there appear to be two Suns wherever it goes. The light emitted by Glimmer is said to illuminate and expose all. Those who have even the slightest shadow in their heart cannot tolerate its light and will fall to their knees. The unwavering power of this Lightstone is said to be capable of raising a heroic spirit to the level of a god.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: This  Spirit of the Earth which has existed for millennia in Raktehelm has absorbed the Dark element and changed over time. Its gigantic body causes people to believe that the darkness of night has taken physical form and come down to the earth. There is also a legend that anyone who touches it will be erased from existence, but this can be attributed to the fear of people who have seen Warg in the flesh. The power of the Demonstone, which devours all is said to be capable of raising a heroic spirit to the level of a god.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Once worshipped as one of the guardian deities of the Dragons, the Fire Dragon God "Magnid" governs Fire, and is said to have been created from the Eternal Flame lit by the Creator God. According to legend, one who bathes in Magnid's blood will gain tremendous power. It is said that many people have challenged the Fire Dragon God over the course of history, but not a single one has returned to tell the tale. The Everlasting Flame contained in its wings would give a heroic spirit the power to surpass God.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Once worshipped as one of the guardian deities of the Dragons, the Water Dragon God "Ul-Megea" governs water, and is said to have been created from a lake of spiritual water by the Creator God. It is said that its blood has the power to draw out latent abilities. It is also said that the blessings of its ever-changing waters affect all living things, and if a species was ever to lose the Water Dragon's divine protection, they would die out immediately. The primordial water contained in its wings would give a heroic spirit the power to surpass God.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Once worshipped as one of the guardian deities of the Dragons, the Earth Dragon God "Romria" governs Earth, and is said to have been born from the overflowing spiritual energy of the World Tree to become the tree's guardian. When war broke out for control of the World Tree, Romria became angered by the fires of war, and let out a roar that echoed across the entire world. which caused every tree to become violent, and the war was ended in an instant. The spiritual power of the World Tree contained in its wings would give a heroic spirit the power to surpass God.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Once worshipped as one of the guardian deities of the Dragons, the Light Dragon God "Arc" governs Light, was born at the same time as the Dark Dragon God "Vajara", with the separation of Heaven and Earth. According to ancient Dragon legends, the Light Dragon God will be the final judge that visits the world, and when the only souls inhabiting the world are corrupted, Arc's roar will echo across the entire world and bring all to an end. The Light of Eternity contained in its wings would give a heroic spirit the power to surpass God.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Once worshipped as one of the guardian deities of the Dragons, the Dark Dragon God "Vajara" was born at the same time as the Light Dragon God "Arc", with the separation of Heaven and Earth. Vajara governs the darkness of night, and is said to be the final judge of sinful souls. Souls that Vajara judges to be guilty are swallowed by its bottomless darkness, and wander the Twilight Realm for all eternity. The abyssal darkness contained in its wings would give a heroic spirit the power to surpass God.
src: Dreg of the Dark Soul exchange
Remnant of a Cursed Soul exchange

items.d: Once worshipped as one of the guardian deities of the Dragons, the Rainbow Dragon God "Paradisos" governs Time, and is said to have existed before Heaven and Earth. It is said to have created all of the Guardian Gods. It watches over the world from far above, and is said to create a guiding rainbow when despair fills the hearts of men. Paradisos resides in the Promised Land. The Hope of the rainbow contained in its wings would give a heroic spirit the power to surpass God.
src: Pinnacle of Glory > [Challenge] Borne by Wishes
Pinnacle of Glory > Borne by Wishes
Blade Vs. Bullet > The Fated Clash
Blade Vs. Bullet > [Challenge] The Fated Clash
Hill of Radiance > [Challenge] Defier of Fate
The Gods' Entryway > [Challenge] Prima Ether Blades
Town of Intersections > [Challenge] Following the Crest
Kidnapped Mikey Part 1 > Toman 2nd Div. Captain
Kidnapped Mikey Part 2 > Toman First Div. Vice Captain
Kidnapped Mikey Part 2 > Toman Vice Leader

items.d: Sorcerer Quon, now the Guardian of the Ancient Forest, was once a Human. However, he chose to throw that away to protect his daughter, who is now Lord of the forest. Yet seeing his daughter now part of the forest tears at his soul. These fragments will tell of his courage, resolve in the name of protecting his friends and family and how resolve itself can be a source of strength.

The fickleness of luck is one of the guiding principles of the world, but on the other hand there are any number of sayings and phenomenon to help prosperity along. And one of those is this, a spiritual crystal condensation of Life Force, the master of nature. It could supply bountiful magical power to any sorcerer, but for a particular sorcerer who manipulates that essential element for life Time and her apprentice, it's a material to amplify their natural abilities tens of times over.
src: The Five Freedom Fighters Last Wishes Passed to the Future

items.d: Everyone who walks the path of mastery spends their lives grapping with the meaning of "ultimate". One answer might lie within the "truth of the world" contained inside this crystal. A naturally occurring spherical manifestation of immovable will, no civilization has ever been able to reproduce it. If a true master obtains one, they may come one step closer to their goal.

The Republic of Gramenia is made up of modern cities scattered among old-growth forests. That natural power seeps from the trees as shining fragments potent enough to turn a barren wasteland lush with green in moments. It flows more readily into Gramenian natives, as if intentionally supporting those who defend the homeland.

The soul fragment of Rosht, a warrior of Dragons with high battle skills. He was prestigious not only for his bravery but also for his noble ambition. This fragment will be the key to open the doors deep inside humans' souls. Although one of the high-rank races which often embrace elitism or militarism, he sought to coexist with other races and balance as a discipline. In other words, his belief follows the idea that living beings are part of this world. To understand how to face universal lives will lead to shine one's soul.

Dragons are said to have the highest biological abilities amongst all creatures. Their scales are harder than any other metal, are not affected by magic, and adjust to any climate.  There are some differences between Dragons depending on their type. However, when it comes to the God Dragon, only a certain sword can slash it. The scales from them will give absolute protection.
src: The Dragon General's Sword > 【EX】 Dragon General Stands
The Dragon General's Sword > 【SPEX】 The Dragon Sword's Attack
The Dragon General's Sword > 【AWK】 Dragon General's Conviction

items.d: The forest is a symbol of life. It represents everything from birth to death, a cycle that balances both a kindness that encompasses all and a ruthlessness that tears all apart. The divine crystals born in these woods mirror this: soft in some places, but rigid in others. Each crystal has the appearance and tranquility of an ancient tree coupled with the intensity of flowing water, which erodes everything with time. Within these crystals lies the power to enhance both ends of this dichotomy of natures.

A fragment of the soul of Pientz, leader of the Crimson Stars circus, beloved pierrot, and secret summoner. This acts as a key to the secret door hidden deep in every person's soul. The smoldering hate hidden behind his smile gave him incredible power. Yet that feeling changed to hope with the sudden chance at a real future: the love of a young woman and the desire to start a family. Hope for tomorrow can cause a soul to sparkle...

Pierrots are known to hide their misery inside. A pierrot must always smile, even when he is mocked...He must pile misery upon misery so that others may laugh. Everything other than the smile must be hidden deep within... This may be the only thing that every sees that hidden face. Indeed, this item would always be at his side as he practiced his tricks alone. Something like this, which has born witness to every hidden emotion, and hours of secret effort, could never betray you.
src: Pierrot of Flames > 【SPEX】 Unleashed Magic Beasts
Pierrot of Flames > 【AWK】 Greatest Show of the Century

items.d: Conflict is inevitable in the world order. Even elements that seem to react to each other violently are a representation of the harmony of nature. The way water and fire cancel each other out is just another perfect arrangement beneath the starry sky. This divine crystal was created under that very arrangement. It has the power to enhance both passionate weapons filled with belief in victory and coldhearted weapons that only know bloodthirsty slaughter.

Call it desire, hope, or dream, it is one of the great motivators of Humanity, and sometimes it can offer incredible strength. It can be like a seething, raging flame, or as a rushing stream of water that transforms by the second. These gems were born when these seething hopes overflowed and crystallized, and can offer great power to those who stand in battle out of deep faith. Justice has as many faces as there are people, but the blade wielded with the strongest will and desire is sure to win through.

This is a fragment of Vicious, the Machine
who unflinchingly devastated whole battlefields for her nation. It serves as a key to secret doors lying deep in every person's soul.
She never doubted her duty to take life, yet the loss of a friend led her to understand hate and know sadness for the first time.
And then she accepted the wishes her friend wanted her to carry and embraced free will. The path by which she gained a heart should help anyone recall how to be a good soul.

The path by which the Machines became as they are now was guided by several inexplicable, supernatural technologies.
One of those is this very unique technique in which a substance is allowed to degenerate to the very limit of existence and then inverted. It is used by many Machines to create massive amounts of energy.
It's original ability was to transform any physical body into a semi-permanent flux state, so if it were turned to a weapon it could have incredible transformative powers. Naturally, though, only for those things made by Machines.
src: Weapon with a Heart > 【EX】Machina Warrior Vicious
Weapon with a Heart > 【SPEX】To Stand in Battle
Weapon with a Heart > 【AWK】Weapon Questioning Peace

items.d: Poison came about as a self-defense tool, created by plants and animals to protect themselves from outside enemies. But of course, people took that tool and turned it into a weapon to harm others. You could say that hatred and self-interest themselves have become a kind of poison. These divine gems were born of all the poisons of the natural world, and resonate with all those who look to harm others out of their own base desires.

There is an azure stele that connects official history and secret records. The shadowed life of one woman, a knight whose name is inscribed in the annals of the Ancient War as one of the Three Blade Masters, is illuminated by a single blaze of light. It is not the sad tale of two sisters who could not be together despite shared blood, but the story of a family united in a single bond while being separated. Their path, engraved on this frozen, azul stone, could likely serve as a guide to those who seek to restore a weapon to its ideal state, holding within it the sleeping power of love.

Every person lives with a single fate. Rarely, there are those who take on another. A certain swordsman gave his entire life to help fulfill the destiny of the sacred sword that chose him. The drops of life force left as he kept moving forward soon condensed and took shape, leaving a glittering trail behind him. These eventually became divine crystals connected to the spirit of the earth, and still, remain today. These stones might have the power to restore the weapons that absorbed the resolve that carried them on a journey of discovery.
src: Misson of the Sacred Sword > 【EX】Edgeless Nogia
Misson of the Sacred Sword > 【SPEX】The Sacred Sword
Misson of the Sacred Sword > 【AWK】The Chosen One

items.d: This is a fragment of the soul of the swordsman Nogia, chosen by the sacred blade and searcher for that which must be slashed. It serves as a key to secret doors lying deep in every person's soul. He believed that he and the blade shared a destiny to slay the unseen, yet ever present "enemy" that haunts everyone, so he sought out truth and fought to end all the problems that plague humans. He sought to make the impossible possible, and his way of life surely helped elevate his soul to a higher plane.

The tantalizing temptation to gain unstoppable power over enemies has consumed the lives of countless warriors.  Some dedicate their lives to mastery of the sword, and others offer themselves to the heavens to achieve supremacy in unarmed battle. The hunger to attain ultimate power bursts forth with every clash of arms, and can become crystallized in an instant to fall over the earth. These stones respond to the deepest wishes of warriors to achieve supremacy and allows them to take their weapons to their ideal form.

A crystal that captivates all who behold its sparkle.
It is said to be made from the crystallized tears shed by a phoenix just before death many ages ago.
It has incredible magical power and is often used in weapons for sorcerers, like staves. However, this crystal only lends its powers to those who desire strength with an unwavering heart. According to legend, there may be another crystal that was created in the same manner, but the truth has been lost to time.

A crystal that captivates all who behold its sparkle.
It is said to be made from the crystallized tears shed by a phoenix just before death many ages ago. Because of its mystical beauty, it is often used to decorate weapons.
However, the crystal only lights up for those who desire strength with an unwavering heart. According to legend, there may be another crystal that was created in the same manner, but the truth has been lost to time.

Sometimes people sacrifice themselves for their loyalty. But only in rare cases, they will give themselves completely. A servant devoted his life to protect his master. The fury he lavished transmuted into a jewel that will no longer cause harm. Its radiance persists until today in a divine crystal, and they say it can shape the ideal weapon, using the loyalty channeled inside it.
src: The Beast's Rampage > [EX] Howl of Fury
The Beast's Rampage > [SPEX] The Raging Rampage
The Beast's Rampage > [AWK] Manifestation of the Tragedy

items.d: A fragment of the soul of Zerkalo, who was a faithful and loyal servant of his master. It is the key to open the door in the depth of his soul. Once his master died he felt his own strength insufficient to protect her new mistress. However, when he received more power, he didn't observe the restriction and he ended up consumed by it. But eventually, it was the bond with the master that saved his soul from darkness. His constant loyalty will elevate his soul and finally free him.

Vermillion wings that represent the passionate souls of those who wore them. There were two swordswomen whose friendship never chaged despite they were parted in space and time. These red feathers like fire guarded the future of the souls of the two lady warriors who whitered away after a life of fightng. The swaying of the red feathers became eventually a pair of wings, and its flapping will eventually entrust the power in the right hands.

These are crystals created by the Machines. To Machines, magical power is equivalent to life force and is thus directly connected to life and death. So, the Machines have long made research into magical power a top priority. These crystals represent some of the fruits of that research. They stand out for their near lossless absorption, storage and release of magical power, and are a high-quality way to supply magical power to Machines, as well as in other uses.

In ancient times, there was a Giant who served as a shield to protect the castle. His enormous body was formidable enough, but it's said that the armor that encased it made with secret techniques of the Giant race was just as sturdy, if not more so. The strong will of the Giant enveloped in flames flowed into every crevice of the armor. Even the shards of the armor are filled with the Giant's heat and powers of protection. These shards may be able to resonate with the will remaining within other Equipment the Giant touched, and give back it back its original power.
src: The Guardian Giant > [EX1] Guardian Giant of Flames
The Guardian Giant > [SPEX] Fiery Fists of Destruction

items.d: A shard of the soul of the Giant Badoul, who dedicated his life to protecting a feudal nation. It can be used as a key to open the door of possibilities deep within the souls of all living beings. Badoul fell into a deep slumber after fighting alongside the founder of a nation in order to become its guardian, but when he awakened, he found that his beloved land had become overrun with the spirits of the dead. With his new master who had been born underneath a star of fire at his side, Badoul launched a counter-attack, desperate to take back the country and rescue it from certain doom. The manifestation of this guardian's devotion will surely strengthen the soul of anyone who obtains it.

In the depths of the Kingdom of Famelle, there is a forbidden place that none may enter. Hidden far within, is a cursed blade, sealed away for safety, of which only a few know.
