This cursed blade, which they say consumes all who dare touch it, is thrust into stone, and sends its dark aura into the very earth. That power has crystallized and is trapped in these stones, which now overflows with dark magic. When used on the blade, these crystals can give it even greater destructive power.
src: The Hero and the Cursed Sword

items.d: It could be said, that in a sense, the way in which an artist seeks perfection and that of a warrior pursuing strength, are one in the same. Obsession in the pursuit of a goal, without that it is not possible to reach the greatest heights, but if one loses their way within their obsession, what they were once seeking becomes warped. This crystal, formed by twisted obsessions, attracts those who have strayed from their path in exchange for power, and leads them even further into the abyss of madness.
src: Mask of Madness > [EX] The Malevolent Puppeteer
Mask of Madness > [SPEX] Reveration of the Mask
Mask of Madness > [AWK] Dance of Madness

items.d: A fragment of the soul of the man named Strife, who belonged to the Spirit people. Strife spent his entire life attempting to create "works of art" out of his own students, in his attempts he even sacrificed the lives of others. A key to unlocking the hidden depth's of one's soul. Held within are the grins he showed to his students, the despair that was felt, the entirety of his ideals towards pursuing the creation of his art. The feelings of his pursuit of his ideal work of art and doing no matter what in the process, will surely radiate within the souls of those who seek the pinnacle of their art.

A material created through brutal magic experiments. It was produced on the backs of innumerable victims so it carries hatred, grudge and melancholy inside it. A superb assassin chose this material to make his blades sharper than any other. Weapons made by this powerful material may turn against their wielder and erode their mind and body, so a strong mental preparation is necessary.

Once there was a flame that never  The blaze consumed all it touched, and even the dragons could only dream of taking hold of it. However, a person giving themselves up in sacrifice to the flames could cause the blazing heat to change to a swirl of magical power, then seal it away in a gemstone. If these gems came to an extraordinary sorcerer, one who could channel the sleeping flames within through a blazing will, their flames could cleanse the world.

In ancient times there was a cave in a country far away, where the storms were asleep. All the winds of this country blew towards the cave and subsided in its depth. One day, a wandering female warrior who was searching for the "Hidden Wind Treasure" found a Rough Gemstone in the cave. They say she broke it to unleash the winds inside and appropriated it. When the owner of this gemstone shakes his weapon, the storms inside awaken incredible power.

When we talk about power, we can't avoid mentioning the innumerable changes of its nature. The impetus of flood that eradicates trees, the vibrancy of life inside the oceans, the flowing of blood inside the veins... Water is the source of all life, and strength. In the Cult's ancient assassination training, it speaks of how "one must flow like water, to control power in all its forms". These sherds come from a sword with that teaching engraved upon it like a curse, and for those who would wield power can open a path like a water cutting through stone.

A scale from the warrior cursed by an Ice Dragon. Throughout history, Dragon scales were highly valued in weapon crafting for their strength and durability, and this one is no different. However, the cursed Human who watched them spread across his body likely regarded such a gift as an abomination.
src: Wrath of the Dragon Slayer > [EX] The Ice Dragon's Curse
Wrath of the Dragon Slayer > [SPEX] Scaled Murderer
Wrath of the Dragon Slayer > [AWK] Unbreakable Tenacity

items.d: A piece of Granith's soul, a pitiful Human caught in the schemes of a crafty Spirit. Though he merely wanted to master the blade, an Ice Dragon's curse gradually turned him into another scaled creature. It contains the hatred of curses and Dragons, the fear of losing himself, and the despair of being unable to fulfill his ambition. Gathering enough of them will unlock an unimaginable power.

Since ancient times, knights have been fighting, risking their lives, for other people. Those people were their leaders, their people, their loved ones.　This stone reflects the souls of the noble knights who continue to fight for those who must defend and continue to prove their fighting spirit, red like the blood flowing through their veins. The knight who carries this stone in battle, therefore, gains the confidence to protect the loved ones.
src: Knights of Blood Act 2: "Famelle Defensive War" -Part 1-

items.d: White dominates all chaos. This jem, born of the Bright Spirit, is a crystallization containing the all-consuming blaze, the wide-spreading sea, the quiet gaze of the trees, and the powers of light and dark. The elements of all creation are contained within, and so this quiet white light that gleams without cease could be said to be a tiny reflection of the world entire. This white light, and its aura of disorder, has the power to control fate itself, and any who take it in hand will gain the power to illuminate the future.
src: Sanctuary of the Bright Spirit > The Gleaming Bright Spirit 【AWK】

items.d: This is a fragment of the soul of the Bright Sphere Spirit Wilkes, who is said to have sealed chaos inside the spheres and imbued them with her blessing. This fragment is a key that opens the doors of living creatures' souls. Since she loathes the impurity of the outer world, she hides in holy precincts and now that she reveals herself, she must have found a truly clear soul. The long ages have not dimmed its brilliance, and it almost looks as if it's trying to return to its original form.
src: Sanctuary of the Bright Spirit > The Gleaming Bright Spirit 【BGN】
Sanctuary of the Bright Spirit > The Gleaming Bright Spirit 【INT】
Sanctuary of the Bright Spirit > The Gleaming Bright Spirit 【PRO】

items.d: This ore has been crystalized with magical power, and it gleams with holy light like a pure mountain spring. It has been used since ancient times to sharpen swords to an unmarred gleaming edge, and at times endows a sheen that reflects the bearer's very soul. One such warrior offered his own body up as the sword of his queen, and they say that by working this ore into his beloved blade, he created a mirror of his very soul. When using this ore as a weapon, it might very well unleash the power to change fate, with its gleam of the spirit like a reflection on a calm blue spring.
src: Knights of Blood Act 2: "Famelle Defensive War" -Part 2-

items.d: A crimson stone found in ruins in an old volcanic region. Many scholars believe that its refinement indicates someone has probably worked it at some point, but no one has yet uncovered the truth of it. This beautiful stone holds incredible fiery magical power, but very few are able to take accept its blessings. A certain swordsman of the Templars used them in his clothing, which allowed him to maximize his power.
src: Knights of Blood Act 3: "The Coffin in the Sky" -Part 1-

items.d: The archeologist Cielo once advanced the theory that the deep ocean floors were once above the ground. The experts were all dismayed and they tried to expell her from the academy. But when this stone, blue as the sky, was discovered on the dark, colorless floor of the ocean, they could do naught by believe. A young sorceress of a certain group of knights was interested in Cielo's records, and began gathering documents in secret to gain possession of one of these divine crystals bearing the name of the sky.
src: Knights of Blood Act 3: "The Coffin in the Sky" -Part 2-

items.d: A sacred stone mainly found throughout the vast land of Garrah. It's said that it got its sinister color is from its origin as the eroded accumulated magic from a deceased Dark Elemental Dragon. It is used as the fuel source for the Arcana Express, and is also a material used to fortify weapons. Because the magical power of the stone increases the closer it is found near Garrah, stones found there are considered extremely valuable, and support the nation's economy with its high price at market.

An orb created from sacred stones found throughout Garrah. Great skill is needed to form the orb shape while maintaining the stones' magical powers, leading to it being incredibly expensive. Kane didn't hesitate to try and to get one the moment he spotted it in Garrah, but Fen had to stop him due to its price point being out of reach for any average citizen.

This is the object in which the incorporeal "Demonic Blood" dwelling inside Demons was sealed and made tangible by an able sorcerer. Although it has properties similar to magical powers, such as strengthening arms and body or recovery from injury and fatigue, the scholars say that "Demonic Blood" acts on the mental, while magic acts directly on the matter. Therefore, they say it is particularly effective on the enhancement of legendary armor protected by the Spirits, or swords inhabited by the swordsmith's soul.

A red and black ore distributed throughout Gormarey. Originally it was an ordinary stone, containing little magic potential, but after the mutation due to the True Eclipse Demonic Blood, its power and solidity have dramatically improved. The perimeter walls of the Demon Fortress of Gormarey aro also made of this material, which contributes to the castle being considered an impenetrable fortress. Also, it has been found that it is highly effective as a material for strengthening armor, but only a few can benefit from its effect.
src: Knights of Blood Act 4: "Bloody Battle of the Capital" -Part 2-

items.d: Far in the East, there was once a Hero who saved a city by sealing a Demon. After a very long time since the hero became a legend, this ore was found in the old battlefields. This ore, which color resembles the surface of water, contains massive magical powers. People from this area use it to forge their weapons.
src: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 1-

items.d: This is an ore that can be mined in the "Hellish Valley," which is located in the North-West of Imari Village. It is said that the beautiful crimson color of the ore is the result of absorbing the blood of shinobi practicing in this area. Swords made from this ore have the best sharpness. Because of its beauty, it is also popular for decoration. Since it is hardly mined, it is dealt with a high price between merchants.
src: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 2-

items.d: Once there was a Demon that repeatedly massacred people and drenched the capital with blood. Time passed by, and people forgot about the incident when the seal was broken. The blazing monster was once again unleashed and destroyed another shinobi village. After the monster left, amaranth colored ores were produced from the ruins of the village. It is said that deep grudges of the shinobi dwell in the ores. If those with negative feelings possess this ore, they will see the deep dark colors inside the shining red color.
src: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 3-

items.d: There were once people who had been burdened with heavy destinies by the Demon Fox. A girl, who lost her country to a disaster. The Imari people, who were involved in the country's downfall. The Yakuno Shinobi, who confronted Imari over the Divine Blade used to seal the Demon Fox. The fates devised for these women by the Demon Fox trifled with their lives, but even as the women suffered countless misfortunes, they continued to fight back. The determination which led them to defeat the Demon Fox is crystallized in this shard. It is said to bestow upon its beholder the power to overcome a cruel fate and seize victory.
src: Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll -Act 4-

items.d: Documents containing confidential records about the Isliid army, such as ongoing operations, personnel rosters, and weapon specifications. Though each individual page offers a mere glimpse into the empire's overall forces, soldiers have a duty to protect them with their lives, even they hold trivia like the emperor's favorite dish or their first crush.

A piece of the soul of Melody, a dancer who fights back against the Demons who have taken over her home country. Despite losing her rank, she still feels a strong duty to protect the populace and carry on her father's will. She strives day after day to make progress towards freedom, no matter how difficult the struggle. That nobility and strength of will also brings inspiration to her comrades.

Small ores formed from an ancient tree's magic, purified over a period of many long years. The name comes from how the ores seem to fall like teardrops from the tree's branches on nights with a full moon. In some areas, this mysterious phenomenon became a point of interest for tourists. Lovers and others who were bound together by a strong connection would go to see the tears for themselves. Perhaps they saw this miracle of time and wished for their relationships to be as eternal as these ores.

An explosive made by condensing magical power into a cylinder. It is sometimes used in weapons. The most famous of these are the magic fireworks of Gran Verge. A mage would control countless turrets fired with magical explosives and set off a beautiful light show of magic fireworks. In the closing years of the Gran Verge kingdom, the fireworks show became more elaborate, with court musicians playing along to the fireworks.

A liquid overflowing with the magical power of processed Adelite Obsidian. Originally, used as fuel for the Arcane Express. However, possessing great adaptability in application, it has seen use in various machines and military equipment as an enhancement material. When near those who are capable in the arts of magic, it releases a radiance of twilight that can be used to determine the amount of magic held within based on the strength of the light it lets forth. Though it is heavily mined within the land of Garrah, they don not possess the capabilities to refine the Adelite Obsidian into Arcanalite.
src: Spy in the Shadows - Forte's Mission

items.d: The fragment of the soul of the guild master of the Reigard Adventurer's Guild and once a commander of Isliid's Self-defense Knight Corps. This fragment is the key to open the doors of living creatures' souls. He once failed at a certain operation, which led to his demotion. However, he did not abandon himself to despair, and his soul continues to burn, as an old soldier who leads the way for young adventurers. His fighting spirit will never break and will awaken the passion in people's hearts.

This is a gemstone that can only be owned by those related to the royal family. It is a masterful example of a technique known only to the royal family's alchemists. In the past, some fools desperate for money tried to pawn some off, but they were turned away because its value was beyond anything that could be paid for with money. However, after a method to mass-produce these gemstones was found, they became readily available as souvenirs for tourists.

The Soul Fragment of the loyal Dragon, Virago, who served the first prince of the Kingdom of Grand Verge, Orvell. This Soul Fragment has the power to call forth the wrath of a dragon, hidden within the very depth of its soul. Having passed an adventurous life serving a member of royalty to be hailed as the Prince of Light, while pushing each other to the greatest of heights. Concealing a Dragon's wrath within, Virago's soul lies in wait for the time it can once return, shining purely and calmly as a display of his logic and strength of mind.

When one speaks of what Dragon's enjoy to do as a pasttime, the first thing that comes to mind would be hoarding treasures. Though the lands may be torn asunder by the passing of time, with little surviving the ravages, there a few rarities in the world such as this Draconic Tear,  a crystalization of emotions that has remained an everlasting object of desire throughout the ages. It is said when the feelings laid arest of those important spill forth in tears, upon the breaking dawn they transform into a gem such as the Draconic Tear. Since times past, many a race have lost control of their very selves in attempts to seek out the Crimson Draconic Tear.

A soul piece belonging to one of the Six Great Demons in the service of the Sin Emperor. It awakens bloodlust in the hearts of Demonkind. Grad lost his left eye in battle but went on to defeat the Gods' commanding officer. Even with a prosthetic replacement, his enemies still tremble in fear of his limitless strength and obsessive vindictiveness. His soul, always hungering for battle, waits to be roused.

An ornament that keeps Ashleigh's long hair in place. Originally a one-of-a-kind work of craftsmanship, many replicas started popping up thanks to the captain's popularity. Already having worn out two of them, this actually comes in handy whenever Ashleigh has to replace it.

Banner used in Bamint's army. A bit plain considering the nation's passion for the arts, but this was a deliberate decision made by the designer. Fed up with gaudy art, they came up with this design which met with surprising applaud in its day. However, modern-day artists have been looking to renew the now-drab design in favor of something more bold — much to the annoyance of the more conservative military force.

The negative emotions of lifeforms will sometimes react with the natural energy of the land. When they accumulate and crystallize, they create what are called Miasma Gems. The dense gases inside flicker like a snake's tongue, mesmerizing the weak-willed. One utterly obsessed with these stones has a strong urge to kill the hated.
src: CROSS THE BLAZE Episode 5 > [SPEX Hyper] All-Consuming Beast

items.d: A Miasma Gem of natural or artificially refined purity. Due to its phenomenal magic conduction, it is often used as a catalyst in sorcery experiments. However, the explosions that occur when its sealed gases are prematurely released have earned it designation as a hazardous material. For that reason, it is rarely found on the open market.
src: CROSS THE BLAZE Episode 6 > [SPEX Hyper] At the Margins

items.d: Instruments made with this produce exquisite tones. They absorb the emotions carried on the performer's breath to refine and amplify them many times over. However, they are also found in instrument-shaped tools of destruction. Sound waves are invisible and too fast to be avoided, making them fearsome when weaponized. Only the high level of expertise they demand prevents widespread use.
src: CROSS THE BLAZE Episode 7 > [SPEX Hyper] Self-Destruction

items.d: This stone has been found all over the world, but its origin is not entirely understood. The fact it's only been excavated from specific places has led to the theory it is formed during cataclysmic events. The vein-like streaks pulse in a manner that cause some scholars to also believe it to be living. Spirit folklore claims it's the fear of the world's end given shape, but this belief has less traction.

A piece of the soul of Chloe, servant to the second prince of Gran Verge. It was the key to awakening the self-sacrifice sleeping in the depths of her Human spirit. Her curse of immortality instantly healed all physical wounds, but the mental scars left her despondent. However, in becoming close with the royal children, her fate changed for the better. She would later recall her time in the kingdom as the best days of her life.

A special mineral found in the Granadia region. Geologists theorize powerful Crest Magic was responsible for its formation. It has a composition similar to ore found elsewhere, but it has a unique pattern. Historians also believe it to hold traces of an ancient power.
src: Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 1- "Dawn of Granadia"
Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 1- "Dawn of Granadia" > [SPEX Hyper] Le Bleu

items.d: A gemstone said to have been steeped in Juno's magical blood. When enough are gathered in one place, their natural resonance will release powerful waves. Those who are sensitive to them will feel nauseous or dizzy, so lengthy exposure is avoided to prevent accidents.
src: Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 2- "The Crimson Queen"
Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 2- "The Crimson Queen" > [SPEX Hyper] World's Rage

items.d: Notes left by the late priestess of Reigrad, Liese's grandmother. Written in blessed ink, they only reveal themselves to the consecrated. Liese, fated to bear the weighty responsibilities of her heritage and profession, received a stern upbringing under her grandmother's watch. However, the comforting warmth inscribed into each page serves as a reminder that it was rooted in love.
src: A Tail of Mystery > [SPEX Hyper] Invasive Species

items.d: An extremely rare mineral only found in the forest near Simon's Hill. It is believed to be made of the woodland creatures' life force, gathered and compressed across countless years. The fact it is most often discovered near places like the lake shore and the cavern entrance supports this theory. Its name comes from the leaf-shaped light flickering at the center.
src: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 1 -The Bullet of Doom
PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 1 -The Bullet of Doom > [SPEX Hyper] The Howling Beast

items.d: A beautiful gemstone found around the empire. Fairly common but eye-catching and easy to work with, it is a popular and affordable ornament. Couples historically exchanged them to profess their love for each other, then jewelers built on the custom by embedding these into paired accessories. Now, wearing one symbolizes commitment.
src: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 2 -Crimson Roar > [SPEX Hyper] Deathclad Beast

items.d: A soul fragment of Nier, a Demon commander who spends her time researching a way to free Za'remnah, one of the Great Six Demons. It unlocks the evil desire sleeping at the bottom of one's heart. Her ultimate goal was the revival of her race, but another urge grips her heart tighter with each humiliating defeat. When the hatred born of that feeling of inferiority dyes it pitch black, a new power will awaken within her for the purpose of taking revenge.

The owner of The Firecat's Den is an expert chef. Although she is already proficient in the cuisine of all cultures, she continues to seek out new flavors to surprise her customers' taste buds. Such commitment has inspired more than a few fledgling cooks, and her blazing zeal contained within this stone guides them along the path to culinary greatness.

A part of the soul of Gilliam, the famed blacksmith of Reigrad. His burning ambition is to craft a weapon mightier than those wielded by the 3 Blade Masters. Not a day passes without the sound of his hammer echoing from his workshop. This piece intensifies the passionate blaze in his eyes, allowing him to find yet-undiscovered branches in the road of metalworking.

A medal fashioned from a jewel that is given in recognition of honorable service to the empire. Their size, shape, and purity level vary by achievement, and the most prestigious are even engraved with miniscule runes. It is believed their cultural foundation lies in how soldiers would compete to collect gems from the beasts they slew as proof of their contribution to the young motherland.
src: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 3  - Impassioned Words > [SPEX Hyper] Ebony & Crimson

items.d: A rare translucent crystal with a dark violet sheen found in imperial mines. When exposed to the immense power of Mavro-halos, it takes on magical properties of its own, glowing like a flickering flame. It is often used in spells with pushing and pulling forces as well as bullet manufacturing.
src: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 4 - Black Steel of Hatred
PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 4 - Black Steel of Hatred > [SPEX Hyper] Soul-Rending Jaws

items.d: Mined from Valkia's southwest mountain range. It is useful for reinforcing weapons and armor due to the high purity level of the magic it contains. A peace treaty with Gara only increased demand since their residents also rely on it in the making of traditional handicrafts. Whenever Airi's treasured blade shows wear and tear, she promptly takes one of these to restore its brilliant shine.
src: Spy in the Shadows - Airi's Mission
Spy in the Shadows - Airi's Mission > [SPEX Hyper] Rampaging Beast

items.d: A translucent mineral found all throughout the empire. Originally colorless, it takes on a purple tint by absorbing magic from the souls that linger in the mines. It is often used in making accessories, but wearing them near large deposits of the same ore can produce strong sensations of deja vu. One theory claims the residual thoughts mixed with the ghosts' magic resonate with each other and amplify.
src: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 5 - Mysterious Sniper > [SPEX Hyper] Hollow Roars

A piece of the spirit of Gaia, a proud God knight who abides by justice. It is the key to reigniting the spark of loyalty in him. Future generations know of him as the Knight of Bravery, who always cut through the front lines and sometimes stood firm to protect his allies. His chivalrous pride serves as a shining beacon to those who seek to follow his path.

Used to fire the bullets loaded into Lyla's gatling gun. The saltpeter comes from Valkia Kingdom's mines, so it has higher magic concentration than normal gunpowder mixes. Lyla prefers this to other kinds of specialized powder since she knows how to best combine it with different types of bullets to match battle conditions.
src: Spy in the Shadows - Lyla's Mission
Spy in the Shadows - Lyla's Mission > [SPEX Hyper] Death's Head

src: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter I
Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter I > [SPEX Hyper] Grim Illusion

items.d: A rechargeable energy source for magic-powered guns. The light-based nature allows for simple conversion into laser beams. The engraved stock circuits include a limiter, but its effect can be reduced or outright removed to match the user's preferences. Some magicians have even turned cartridge circuit modification into a career.
src: PHANTOM SNIPERS Episode 6 - Shadowed Red > [SPEX Hyper] Depths of Madness

items.d: A fragment of the soul of Rayas, an expert adventurer from Reigrad. It is the key to igniting his inquisitive nature. Inherent curiosity led him to uncovering one of the world's secrets before. Although he must mind his words and deeds as his responsibilities increase with his achievements, the desire to seek the unknown at his core remains unchanged. When his battle against the Ancients comes to an end, he will continue on a new journey along with his constant companion.
src: The Knight's Sword > [Challenge] The Blade Awakens

A beautiful gemstone found throughout the empire. Fairly common and easily workable, it makes for cheap jewelry with broad appeal. They were customarily exchanged by couples to profess their love, so jewelers started to create paired accessories using them. This fashionable tradition is so widespread that people from Isliid are relatively easy to spot abroad.

items.d: Often used to decorate ceremonial outfits. Although it has no magical properties, absorbing sunlight can let it give off a faint glow for up to several days. There is also a custom in the northeastern regions to place one on the departed's grave. That light is believed to represent their soul, fading after passage into the afterlife.

items.d: The cape belonging to Charlotte, granddaughter of Hero of Famelle Zeorg. He gave it as a gift on her tenth birthday after learning what she liked through awkwardly indirect questions. She managed to guess his intent, but the cute design along with the thought behind its selection genuinely pleased her.

Material needed to craft

*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

A portion of the soul of Ginzo, a legendary ninja from the far eastern village of Imari. It is the key to unlocking his potential forgotten by history. An inseparable part of shinobi history, he has watched over the village and witnessed much death and bloodshed over the centuries. The burning spirit rids his heart of all discontent, serving to awaken a similar loyalty in others.

A charm engraved with a unique symbol. It attaches an evil spell to the target's shadow, letting it follow them until their ultimate death. As few Humans know the symbol's meaning, its origins are strongly believed to lie beyond the Great Seal's formation.
src: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 1

items.d: A charm engraved with a unique symbol. It creates a hollow figure in the shape of a person or animal, but controlling it with any precision demands both technique and a strong mind. The high difficulty to master this technique has left few practitioners in the modern age, and it is in danger of becoming a lost art.
src: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 2

"Empress' Outfit EV"
*To craft equipment, go to Equip > Crafting

A crystal naturally formed by strong winds and cold water. Its inherent ability to store magic is much loved by jewelers, but a certain level of technique is needed to prevent shattering it. As a result, anyone who can properly handle this material is a true craftsman, making it a literal touchstone of success.

A crystal containing the spirit of Elpneumas, ruler of Smogdragon Island. Its essence can be either a panacea or a fatal poison to living creatures. This orb unlocks the vitality that forms the root of power. It questions one's nature, experience, and most of all, conviction to release latent memories inside the soul. By accepting their self and their previous mistakes, one can ascend to a new level of strength.
src: Kill la Kill > [SPEX] Assault of the Mimics

items.d: A crystal containing the spirit of Ugetsu, ruler of Flametail Mountain. Its essence wraps the soul in a scorching blaze. This orb unlocks the vitality that forms the root of power. It forces one to face the prospect of their eventual demise. By accepting that and still embracing their commitments with the same ardor, one can ascend to a new level of strength.
src: Valerie & the Magic of Muscle > Magical Prelude
Valerie & the Magic of Muscle > Magical Incompletion

items.d: A charm engraved with a unique symbol. It channels emotion to temporarily increase the user's talents. In periods when the shinobi valued strength at any cost, it was indispensable. However, the emerging link between heavy usage and low self-esteem convinced those above a certain social status or skill level to put it away.
src: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 3

items.d: A portion of the soul of Hakuro, cunning elder of the far eastern village of Imari. It is the key to unlocking his full potential. Revered for his deep understanding of shinobi history, he continues to walk the path of tradition regardless of the changing times. His unwavering spirit inspires resoluteness and diligence in others.

Material required for crafting
"Subaru's Cell Phone EV"
*To craft equipment, go to Equip > Crafting
src: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in a Summoner's World -Part 1-

items.d: A charm engraved with a unique symbol. It places the user under its effects by suppressing their thoughts. Despite the short duration, overuse causes the mind to wither like a dry plant from lowered activity. This helps prove the constant cycle of forming and releasing thoughts lets one's spirit thrive.
src: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 4

items.d: A crystal containing the spirit of Fongion, ruler of Eternaglint Summit. Its essence increases the flow of time for the soul. This orb unlocks the vitality that forms the root of power. It allows for instantaneous evolution, provided the temporal rapids do not erode the mind first. Only by possessing a will impervious to passing ages can one ascend to a new level of strength.
src: Kill la Kill > [SPEX Hyper] The Mutant Species

items.d: A charm engraved with a unique symbol. It puts immense pressure on the user's heart to accelerate blood flow. This not only increases physical endurance and strength, but also simplifies mental processes to dull pain and sharpen reflexes. In short, they turn into a tool for combat. Shinobi use this as a last resort when neither retreat nor failure are allowed.
src: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 5

items.d: A crystal containing the spirit of Stiria, ruler of Frostsprite Tundra. Its essence leads the soul into a freezing wasteland. This orb unlocks the vitality that forms the root of power. Even the fiercest resolve can be overwhelmed where air, ground, and time itself are frozen still. By keeping their zeal at the core burning bright, one can ascend to a new level of strength.
src: Kill la Kill > [EX2] Pulling the Strings
Valerie & the Magic of Muscle > Magical Nerves

items.d: A herb with a variety of uses. It grows mainly in monster-inhabited areas like forests and absorbs their magic. Simmering it produces a substance that forcefully stimulates cellular activity, letting someone on the brink of exhaustion run an entire marathon. However, when the effect wears off, the results can be devastating. Many jokingly call it the "Energy Loan Shark".

Famed for having many applications since ancient times. As the Unicorn chiefly eats enchanted plants, its horn is a superb magical conductor. The toughness also makes weapon-crafting an obvious choice. However, the discovery of mind-altering properties then started its use in love potions. This additionally destroyed the old belief that Unicorns befriended maidens as love-starved women hunted them in droves.

An imitation of Mei-Mei's fountain pen. The original uses Luminosity instead of regular ink, unlike this one. It is often used to write copies of older texts, mostly related to law. Rather than simply reproduce the script, it reaches into the intent of the original lawmaker. This allows for accurate rewording in modern language, the prime objective of a Lithomancer.
src: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter Ⅱ

items.d: A charm engraved with a unique symbol. It contains a shinobi's final missive before their death, acting like a last will. Techniques, training methods, talisman usage, and shinobi history are all conveyed in a concise manner, but only those of a similar bloodline can interpret the meaning. This highly secretive form of communication is also a type of ninjutsu.
src: New Legend of the Forbidden Ninja Scroll Act 6

items.d: A type of magical ore found sporadically around the outskirts of Granadia's capital. During the Demon Lord's battle against a massive army, his outflowing mana infused itself into the surrounding environment. It is valuable in forging blades but lacks the resilience to serve as core material, and the reddish parts actually increase fragility. No technique can separate the weaknesses from the strengths, so blacksmiths jokingly call it "the Demon Lord's Tear".
src: Knights of Blood: The New Demon Lord

items.d: A blue gallstone from a monster in the care of gang leader Payne. Rare and beautiful, he thought to try selling them to rich collectors. This idea succeeded beyond all expectations, turning them into a key source of funding.
src: Blue Jacket Part I: The Lone Wolf

items.d: A rare gemstone found in the deep ocean. Magma from underwater volcanoes is said to crystalize after many years. The purity of a specimen can be measured by its translucence. Surfers in particular prize them as charms, fashioned into necklaces and bracelets. However, the high-quality ones are only allowed to be worn by experts.

A glass fragment polished by waves over a long period of time. They are not particularly valuable, but their beauty makes them popular as interior decorations and accessories among women. Enthusiasts believe they represent the artistry of nature and frown upon dramatically changing their shapes.

Material needed to craft
"Gabimaru's Mask EV"
*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

Material needed to craft
"Chobe's Necklace EV"
*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

Originally meant as a warning when pirates were spotted in the surrounding waters. It has since been adopted by pirates themselves as their symbol, with numerous variants on the design. The Rook Pirates used the classic black flag behind a skull wearing a captain's hat. Such a stylish yet relatively simple look may have represented adherence to their roots.

A magical storage device. Specially made by Rosetta, its capacity and output are far greater than previous types. It lets her operate the Rosetta Arm without needing to expend her own mana. Compact and easy to carry, the only shortcoming is how there are two lone recharging spots -- her laboratory and the Great Granadia -- which proves inconvenient at times.

An official bulletin issued by the empire when a criminal or suspect is at large. Knights receive them directly to memorize the targets' profiles. Whoever apprehends a perpetrator will receive monetary rewards and national honors. For this reason, there is sometimes internal competition as to who can catch the most.
src: Blue Jacket Part II: The Rookie Tracer

items.d: A hollowed-out pumpkin overflowing with candy. Sold around Halloween, they are made for kids but also popular with adults wanting a quick supply of snacks to give trick-or-treaters. The frenzy after they hit shelves means their intended customers can never buy them without parental assistance.

A manuscript about Pola, Witch of Funeral Flowers. It was not written by a Lithomancer but one of her fans. The content is loyal to the established setting only to add a number of new developments and even characters. Regardless, even sticklers for historical accuracy find it enjoyable. The overflowing love and admiration for Pola contained in the text are very much in line with Grimm Stella's own.
src: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter III

items.d: A crystal containing the spirit of the Adventurers' Guild leader in Reigrad. It is the key to reignite that dynamism from his youthful days. His first battle's intensity, duels against mighty enemies, shedding blood to protect the homeland, lost comrades -- each memory drifts about deep in his heart like glowing embers. They now gather into a towering blaze, and the berserker whose name commanded awe and respect across the Human nations is reborn.
src: Pride of the Warrior > [DREAM] The Legendary Guildmaster

items.d:
Material needed to craft
"Vorpal Chopper EV"
*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

Material needed to craft
"Pencilgon's Earrings EV"
*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

A serum created by processing a certain person's blood. Taking it into the body dramatically amplifies one's physical abilities. The intent was to make superior Humans, but adverse reactions warped every test subject beyond recognition. Though discarded as a failure, someone managed to save a batch, and rumors claim research is continuing in secret.
src: Blue Jacket Part III: The Scarlet Enforcer

items.d: An orb created by the hermit-like alchemist Laiole. Its shape changes according to the user. In Laiole's case, she purportedly transformed it into a magical cannon and single-handedly defeated the enemy army threatening her loved ones. In Liza's case, it changed into a pretty dress during her fight against the Goldola. Although not meant for battle, it was devastating in a different sense.

A part of the soul of Edram, a mechanical soldier in the (abusive) employ of Demon noblewoman Riffili. It is the key to activate his reactor core. Analysis revealed this piece is made of Prima Ether, the materialized thoughts of all living things. It proves that, despite being a Machine, even he has a heart -- one which feels discontent, anger, exasperation, and fondness towards his owner.

The latest revision of an experimental enhancing drug. It not only improves one's physical attributes; magic-independent talents called Gifts also manifest in the rare case of full adaption. Unlike the previous batch, neither dramatic mental disturbances nor monstrous transformations have been observed (so far). For that reason alone, some regard this as a success even if further breakthroughs never come.
src: Blue Jacket Part IV: A New Threat

items.d: A fountain pen given to the novice Lithomancer Jun. Although the basic design resembles that of his master Yu-Long's, the details match his own preferences. The pale light from the Magistone tip bestows an air of majesty. If the user faces themselves and the story in the manuscript, this can let them write a miraculous experience for the reader.
src: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter IV

items.d: Also known as a Weeping Gem for its aqua blue color. As beautiful as the limpid southern seas, it is believed to be the solidified tear of a mermaid, but the truth of this is unclear. Young women value it as a good luck charm for romantic pursuits. However, most tales about mermaids have tragic endings, casting doubt on such benefit.
src: Noble Vacation: The Beasts' Island and the Mermaid's Curse

items.d: A miniaturized telephone invented by the R&D department of Elements. The operative range is also smaller, but it has a number of other functions convenient in a military setting such as voice recording. Charlotte uses that rarely since she dislikes how different her voice sounds outside of her head.

A crystal containing the spirit of a Weapon-Ear chief. It holds her unshakeable belief that everyone can live together in peace. No matter how many hardships and struggles she encounters, her mind is strong enough to always face forward. She naturally lightens the mood and touches the hearts of many, helping them achieve their goals.

Recovered from the head of the Blau Ritter destroyed by Natasha's unit. Analysis revealed that it acted as an eye that sent a visual feed to the cockpit. The non-Human design concept served as a valuable technological sample. Six in all were obtained, but one was accidentally cracked by Honoka of the Second Squad, earning her the R&D chief's wrath.
src: TotRS Chapter 2: The Demons' New Weapon

items.d: Bright crimson crystals found scattered around the amnesiac Menas when she first appeared in the rose garden. The flickering blaze inside holds her exact same magic, prompting the theory they were extracted. The academy's researchers questioned her in hopes to learn more, but she could only retort, "How am I supposed to know anything when I lost my memories?"
src: Mena Soars High Act 1: Bridal Court

items.d: A new model of fountain pen for the Lithomancer Yu-Long. Calling to mind a connection of stars, it amplifies the ability to seek out common features between objects and concepts to link them. Even in books where several words have been illegibly blurred, he can use this to repair those blanks with contextual clues, authorial intent, and the trends of the period.
src: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter V

items.d:
Material needed to craft "Kenshin's Kimono EV"
*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

Material needed to craft "Saito's Uniform EV"
*To craft, go to Equip > Crafting

The fountain pen of Witch and Lithomancer Selia. She received it from her father, the master author Grimm Stella. His thoughts and emotions pour out of the Magistone tip whenever she writes with it. Clasping the fear, anxiety, envy, and excessive joy that accompany the act of creation, she continues his story.
src: Grimm Stella & the Great Six Witches Chapter VI

items.d: Naturally sturdy and magic-resistant, it is treasured in making shields and armor. As the name implies, the most common color is a morose shade of violet, but some fragments shine brighter in a light florid hue. These are Echika's favorite, calling them "Rock Hydrangeas" which rest near the windows of the student council room.
src: Mena Soars High Act 2: Fraudulent Romance

items.d: A rare gem found in north Isliid's mountain range. It contains high-density magic that occasionally flashes dazzling gold. As that region is prone to thunderstorms, people once believed they were crystals transformed by lightning strikes. Research later established a more plausible theory they were byproducts of a large-scale spell of golden energy the Supreme Witch used in the area.

An artifact crafted by Atra. It magically generates an odor unpleasant to Magibeasts when flammable material such as grass is placed in the mouth-like opening and the ignition mechanism is activated. The resulting smoke has practically no effect on non-Magibeasts, but it can expose the user's location.

Material required for crafting
"Knight Killer EV"
*To craft equipment, go to Equip > Crafting

Material required for crafting
"Iron's Shield EV"

Also called Nilkanar's Seed. It resembles the projectile of a high-caliber rifle, purportedly fashioned out of the seed of a large tree somewhere in this world. The creator kept that identity as a seed with the hope it would start a new paradigm.

An item that appeared in the 16th episode of "The Magical Primawitches - Twin Fairies". It was created by the emotion from the Manstor of Envy, Revia Sylphid. It was then stolen by Master Thief A, who called it Invidia.
The soul fragment of the Leader of "Dark Matter," used to unleash the true powers of its beholder.

The fragment of the spirit of Toshizo Hijikata,
the vice-commander of the Shinsengumi and is now an escaped prisoner hunting for Ainu Gold.
Having a violent past and endless desire in his soul, his passion carries him to heights ordinary people cannot even imagine.
His soul is one of endless energy that refuses to age.
The soul fragment of Rimuru, a slime that was reincarnated to a different world. Born under a star with many ups and downs, it hides eternal possibilities. It will gain even more powers by training.

A crystal containing the spirit of Reigrad's master blacksmith. It contains his experience from crafting hundreds of thousands of arms. The knowledge gained by engaging with material of all kinds allows him to draw out a weapon's ultimate potential no matter its origin, condition, or wielder. The day when he becomes famous the world over is surely near.

A crystal containing the spirit of the head chef at the Firecat's Den. It holds all of her memories of cooking. The very first dish she made was an awful mess that her father ate joyfully. Ever since that day, she hoped to bring real smiles to everyone through her meals. She continues to spread cheer and contentment, her untiring effort creating unforgettable memories.
src: The Master Chef's Test > [DREAM] Crème de la Crème

items.d: A crystal containing the spirit of a Demon army commander. It holds all of his memories of battle. His pride is so great that he does not forget; humiliating defeats loom large in his mind. His pride is so great that he does not forgive; stronger opponents become targets for vengeance. The insatiable thirst to conquer drives his ascent towards supremacy.

A crystal containing the spirit the steadfast God warrior Gaia. It holds the memories of his triumph over a history of deadly battles. Even with his life on the line, he always valued loyalty above all. That commitment was reflected in his swordplay, each slash swift and unrelenting to carry him through one raging conflict after the next. His life is exemplary for all who walk the path of chivalry.
src: Ravage of the Azure Swordsman > 【DREAM】Streak of Devotion

items.d: These creatures possess an unknown heat source within them, and merging one with a fire hero soul can improve its abilities. They're a sought-after prize for any adventurer seeking mighty hero souls, but actually getting your hands on one is extremely difficult. Besides their inherent rarity, they're far more aggressive than their appearance would suggest, and will self-destruct as a defense mechanism, taking its surroundings with it... Or so the rumors say, anyway.

The heat within a Hot Egg provided plenty of nutrition for it to grow into a Hot Chicken, and because the heat source has grown with it, it can provide even more growth when absorbed by a fire hero soul. Hot Chickens create hot gusts of wind with a slight flapping of their wings, making them even harder to catch. Some rumors even say they can breathe fire! Emphasis on the rumor part, of course. They're super cozy to hold.

The heat source of a fully grown Hot Chicken is hot and compact enough to be compared to a furnace core. Their massive bodies always seem like they're about to blow, and you might get singed just trying to get in range: not an easy bird to catch. Hero souls that fuse with one can produce enough heat to warm an entire country, and a single King Hot Chicken is said to be worth as much as a 10,000 man army division.

items.d: A squishy lifeform filled with transparent, water-like fluid. Merging one with a water hero soul can improve its abilities via contact with the super pure fluids produced within. They're a must for adventurers seeking flexible hero souls, but good luck finding some. Due to their amphibious nature makes them hard to find, and if they sense danger, they'll quickly make themselves in a rubber ball-like shape in order to bounce far, far away.

What's surprising about the Aqua Egg is that, despite being so squishy, it nonetheless takes the shape of a bird following incubation, and even gains the ability to fly. As it grows, the amount of fluid produced within its body increases, which should result in an even greater power boost for any water hero soul it merges with. They're even harder to catch now that they can fly, however. And adventurers love their unique squishiness, too!

When an Aqua Chicken fills with pure fluid, it puffs up and expands to a size inconceivable for a mollusk: getting hit by one would probably shatter
every bone in your body. That it doesn't split apart despite its size makes it a natural wonder. A water hero soul that absorbs one of these gains incredible power, as if its entire body was suffused with holy water. Some even think it hails from some kind of long lost paradise...

items.d: Though it looks like a lone egg, this is actually an elusive plant lifeform that takes the form of a seed covering. Filled with the robust nutrients of the earth, any forest hero soul that absorbs one will gain a considerable power boost. A must-have for any adventurer seeking healing hero souls, but actually finding them is quite difficult. They possess an instinctual desire NOT to be caught, and flee from sight as soon as someone draws near, you see.

Though various biologists have spent years theorizing on the subject, none can conclusively say what came first: the chicken or the seed. They've absorbed a tremendous amount of energy from the soil in order to grow, but that energy hasn't been lost. Far from it! In fact, a forest hero soul that merges with one will get a significant boost to its healing powers. Plus, being able to catch one as it flies about of its own volition would make a fine tale for the guild!
src: Knights of Blood: Zero -Part 2- "The Crimson Queen" > Tomorrow and Tomorrow

A forest hero soul that merges with one attains natural energies as boundless and expansive as the land itself. Stories tell of a tribe that once saw the King Leaf Chicken as a god, and worshipped it accordingly. Hardly surprising, considering the powers it holds...

items.d: An electric lifeform said to have come to earth alongside lightning itself. Though alive, it possess a power generator inside that amplifies the energy of any light hero soul it merges with. Adventurers in pursuit of radiant hero souls need them, but actually acquiring Light Eggs is tricky - and dangerous. Even if you can find their lightning-prone hiding spots, approaching carelessly will get you shocked instantly, or cooked to a crisp if you accidentally hurt the Egg's feelings.

When the power generated inside a Light Egg exceeds a certain amount, it sheds its shell to take the form of a chicken. Light Chickens can zip through the sky to absorb electricity, storing up shocking amounts of energy. If a light hero soul absorbs one, it can gain an explosive amount of energy. You'll need to prepare yourself physically and emotionally to deal with lightning strikes from the sky if you want to get your hands on one. While wearing rubber gloves, of course.

The amount of electricity necessary to birth a King Light Chicken is said to be enough to power an entire country. They're practically like little electric power plants, and any adventurer trying to capture one does so with their life on the line. A light hero soul that merges with one will gain energy that feels a little like a series of explosions are going off inside you. In a good way. Historians theorize these creatures hold the key to explaining ancient Machine power sources.

items.d: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Spirits tend to be proficient in magic and healing, and are rarely seen specializing in armed combat. Among this rare breed, the Kilmon is rarer still, and is brave enough to be tasked with leading  advance strike teams. Its appearance belies incredible charging power that has sent many an enemy flying. A hero soul that obtains its power will see its attacks made sharper and more powerful as well.

A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Those Kilmons that attain noteworthy proficiency in combat receive a king's crown as proof. They serve as leaders for other Kilmons, and are tasked with seeing strike operations through to success. Having a king overseeing an attack-focused operation fills a Kilmon with a sense of gratitude. A hero soul that receives a Kilmon King's power will reach an even deeper understanding of combat.
src: Spirits of the Exploring > Spirits of the Exploring 【BGN】
Spirits of the Exploring > Spirits of the Exploring 【PRO】

items.d: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. After achieving significant experience and battlefield accomplishments, a King transforms into a God. Worshipped by some tribes as a war god, a squad with the protection of a God is said to be undefeatable in combat. Its tactics are focused entirely on offense, free of waste, beautiful. Hero souls that receive the life-and-death power of a God stand at the zenith of combat prowess.

A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Though Spirits traditionally excel in magic and healing abilities, battles against other races naturally led to the rise of Spirit defense specialists, with the Defmons being toughest of all. They can withstand strikes from the hardiest of foes, routing the advance of countless assaults. A hero soul that attains their sturdy durability will come even closer to mastering the art of defense.

A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A Defmon that accumulates significant experience earns the title of King. They offer impregnable defense to any unit they lead, keeping enemies at bay no matter how powerful they may be. This puts them odds with their offensively-focused Kilmon brethren, however. A hero soul that acquires a King's power will become that much more an expert in the art of defense.
src: Spirits of the Exploring > Spirits of the Exploring 【INT】
Spirits of the Exploring > Spirits of the Exploring 【PRO】

items.d: A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A King who protects its allies ascends to Godhood. Because of a God's ability to win battles without harm coming to any of its allies, earning it praise from even non-combatants. Seafarers worship Defmon Gods as protectors of the sea lanes. A hero soul that acquires the indomitable power of a God will be that much closer to attaining the pinnacle of defense.

A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Tufmons are endurance personified, and are said to walk for three days straight without stopping as part of their training. The endurance they attain allows them to provide support and fight without so much as breaking a sweat. A hero soul that attains their power will become that much more persistent, that much more the spirit of endurance itself.

A member of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. A Tufmon whose toughness has been recognized receives the title of King, and assumes this form. They frequently serve as arbitrators when Kilmons and Defmons butt heads, often ending up worse for wear in the process. Because only Tufmons can fulfill this role, however, they're essential to the squad. A hero soul that attains a King's power reaches a greater understanding of endurance.
src: Spirits of the Exploring > Spirits of the Exploring 【ADV】
Spirits of the Exploring > Spirits of the Exploring 【PRO】

items.d: A Tufmon that accumulates years of experience transforms into a God. During a castle siege, when Kilmons and Defmons argued for their respective philosophies, Tufmon suggested persuading the ramparts to their cause. The ploy worked, and the castle opened its gates without violence, and the Kilmons and Defmons had to acknowledge they'd been outdone. A hero soul that attains the power of a God may just become endurance personified.

items.d: Standard bread with a twist. It's eaten in the Raktehelm region. It stays fresh for longer than normal bread, and is popular with adventurers who want a light meal for their travels. Its main ingredient, flour, is available in a number of sources, but discerning adventurers are said to prefer flour from the Kingdom of Famelle. However, since bread made in this region has the same effects as any other bread, most people aren't too picky.

Perfect for those adventurers who aren't satisfied by regular-sized bread, it's also an essential item for families and people travelling in large groups. Its well-browned crust and fluffiness are loved by the people of Raktehelm. Each country makes bread that looks and tastes different, from thin, flat bread, made with lots of salt, to tube-shaped bread with a hard crust, to rectangular bread that is incredibly soft.

Commonly thought to be a type of bread, brioche is made from the same ingredients as pastries, and can be classified
as such. When baked like a pastry, it often has spices mixed into the dough and topped with preserved fruits. The Principality of Bamint's third princess apparently troubled her servants when she declared that, "Brioche is...not a pastry! So we can eat as much as we like!".

A dried sausage often used as a pizza topping, or to go with alcoholic drinks. Salami is now a popular choice for the dinner table, although it was originally invented as a long-lasting food to be carried by soldiers. Many travellers who journey long distances take salami with them. The guild master of Reigrad Guild, one of the Isliid Empire's Adventurer's Guilds, always brings homemade salami when he drinks.

Juicy meat cooked to perfection while still on the bone. Adventurers are often seen eating ribs in the street, so it is also known simply as "Adventurer Food". When the Adventurer's Guild was asked how it should be cooked, they said, "On your travels, catch an animal, cook it and eat it." One fledgling adventurer said the desire to eat ribs in places he'd never been before was the reason he entered the profession.

A reproduction of a meal eaten by hunters from before the ancient war, when hunters would butcher dragons for their meat. In Raktehelm nowadays, "Dragon Steak" refers to processed meat cooked with spices and other condiments to resemble actual dragon meat. It is not made from real dragons. However, among gourmets, it is rumoured that somewhere in Raktehelm, dragon steak is still made from real dragon meat.

Fish Fillets are slices of freshly caught saltwater fish. In most countries, fish is only eaten after it has been cooked, but it is said that in the eastern part of Gramenia Republic, fish can be eaten raw, as "Sashimi", or on top of rice mixed with vinegar, as "Sushi". Interestingly, although the Paw People love eating them, for some reason, they just won't admit it.

Crispy on the outside and deliciously fluffy on the inside. A new adventurer once heard from a woman who served as the high priestess of a shrine in Reigrad that eating fish makes you more intelligent. The adventurer ate only fish for a period of time, but one day, the owner of Fire Mountaincat who heard his story told him that it wouldn't do him much good unless he ate the fish raw. Hearing this, the adventurer was so shocked that he cried himself to sleep that night.

Sardines baked with spices. The fragrance of the spices and the exquisite taste of the salt explode on the tongue as you bite into this dish. Although usually paired with alcoholic drinks, some shops serve grilled sardines with fried rice. They are a favourite of the second in command of the Magus Empire of La Riiz's 3rd Magus Division. Also known as the Blue-eyed Black Fox, she can be found enjoying cocktails with grilled sardines in a downtown bar in La Riiz.

Juicy, bright red tomatoes. The Kingdom of Famelle is known for producing this fruit, and exporting it in massive quantities to restaurants and other buyers all across Raktehelm. This fruit is essential for a healthy diet, and is recommended by the Adventurer's Guild for people who do not eat regular, balanced meals. However, there are rumours that Reigrad's Guild Master can't stand them...

A delicious lettuce eaten in everyday salads, wrapped around fried meat, or in sandwiches. According to Raktehelm's tourism guide, "Rakshuran", there is a trend among women to make it into a smoothie. A member of the Principality of Bamint's Royal Knights has been seen frequently drinking this smoothie in various places.

Croutons and a special dressing called Caesar Salad Dressing adorn Romaine Lettuce and other vegetables to create this meal.
"The name Caesar is from a famous soldier of the past."
"You know a lot about it, Rayas."
"Don't teach Iris things that aren't true! It's actually the name
of the cook who invented it! Any cook knows that!"
"Oh, so you lied to me, Rayas."

Salad served in a large bowl with plenty of green and yellow vegetables. It is popular in many households as it is both delicious and highly nutritious. Although easy to prepare, gathering the ingredients can be difficult. The leader of the Principality of Bamint's Royal Knights, who had almost no cooking experience, learned to make it after the owner of Fire Mountaincat told him,
"...Alright, even you should be able to make this!"
It still took a few sacrifices, though.
src: Caesar Salad ×2, Tomato ×1, Romaine Lettuce ×1 (89% success)

items.d: Fried egg laid on thickly buttered slices of toast. It's notorious for its tendency for the egg yolk to make a mess while you're eating it. Ever since the first performance of "The Ends of Calvaria" at the theatre in the Kingdom of Famelle, where the protagonist is seen to enjoy eating it, this simple dish gained popularity for a time. It tastes just as you would expect.

A sausage filled to burst with meat and cooked until the skin is crispy, placed inside a bread bun with lettuce and ketchup. It is popular as a light and easy meal in cities in the Isliid Empire, where it is sold at stands in the streets. A female receptionist at the arena in this city ate one at a street stall one day and liked it very much. Since then, she eats one every day for lunch.

A jam-packed sandwich for those working people who are not satisfied with a hotdog. Scrambled egg and vegetables such as lettuce, tomato and cucumber are sandwiched between thick slices of bread. As if that weren't enough, Teriyaki chicken is also included in this special Fire Mountaincat sandwich. It is reasonably priced, and enjoying one for lunch at Reigrad's famous blacksmith is one of the city's pleasures.

Rice fried with meat and vegetables, and finally boiled in a soup. The rice, which fills your mouth with flavour as you chew, and the soup, which soaks into the other ingredients, are a perfect match. There are various adaptations of this dish throughout Raktehelm, but the most popular is found at Fire Mountaincat. Historians believe Pilaf is the oldest rice cuisine in Raktehelm, and evidence strongly suggests that it originated in the midwestern part of the Gramenia Republic.

Standard Pilaf, which also includes fresh seafood. Pilaf originally used meat rather than fish and shellfish, but these recipes changed over the course of time in coastal areas where fishing was commonplace. Shellfish extracts give the dish its rich fragrance and deep flavour. This Pilaf is popular on the Sadahl Coast, and the residents eat it at least once a week.

Alongside Mixed Pilaf, a luxurious version of American Paella is eaten during celebrations in the cities on the Sadahl Coast in the Gramenia Republic. This Paella uses only the very best ingredients. Gramenia Paella is made with many vegetables such as onions and bell peppers, and seafood such as mussels, squid and shrimp. Gourmets travel from all across Raktehelm to taste it. It is also one of Gramenia's Chief of Staff's favourite dishes.
src: Mixed Pilaf ×1, Dragon Steak ×1, Grilled Sardines ×1 (89% success)

items.d: The taste of home for the fishermen of Raktehelm. It was originally made as a pre-prepared meal for fishermen to drink during breaks at work. A man who became a cook after retiring from fishing improved the recipe, and remembering his days as a fisherman, decided to serve it at his restaurant. The dish soon gained a reputation far and wide. The warm soup with its shellfish extracts give the person who drinks it a sense of blissful peace.

Prawns, with their giant claws had long been an irritant for the fishermen of Raktehelm, because they would cut the nets. However, one fisherman decided to try boiling a prawn that came up with his catch, and it turned out to be delicious. It is said that prawns have been eaten here ever since. According to gourmets, the best way to eat it is to pour miso soup into the shell of the prawn's head, and to dip the meat into it.

This dish dates back to when a gourmet from the Magus Empire of La Riiz, alongside his magical research, decided to make "A noodle dish that no one has ever seen before!". These noodles are made with a Fire Mountaincat original recipe, and a Reigrad blacksmith and a Guild Master from the same city cry:
"Noodles with roast pork, well-soaked! Fresh shrimp and shellfish toppings!"
"It goes amazingly well with Seafood Soup! The thick noodles mix well with the soup!

A medicinal mushroom. When used properly, it can cure loss of speech. However, misusing it will leave you with some serious side effects.
"Rayas, this is a Red Mushroom. You shouldn't eat it as it is, obviously, but if you do eat it raw…"
"Ganan! Is this how you're gonna teach us? Put some more passion into it. Come on, now!"
"...Was I too late?"

A medicinal mushroom. When used properly, it can cure loss of vision. However, misusing it will leave you with some serious side effects.
"Rayas, this is a Blue Mushroom. It can be used as an antidote, but eating it raw has some side effects…"
"Ganan, an idiot like me can't be an adventurer. The furthest I can go is for a walk around the neighbourhood."
"Is that something a glutton like you can say?"

A medicinal mushroom. When used properly, it can cure paralysis. However, misusing it will leave you with some serious side effects.
"Rayas, you don't need to tell me about Yellow Mushrooms. You eat them after you've heated them, right?"
"That's… Hehe… Are you acting? ...I can't take it... Hahaha!"
"I feel like you can just throw that one out..."

A medicinal mushroom. When used properly, it can cure most poisons. However, misusing it will leave you with some serious side effects.
"Be really, really careful with this one. If you eat it raw, it could kill you."
"Gana- Ugh…! Uhh…!"
"Rayas! Stay with me! Raaayce!"

A medicinal mushroom. When used properly, it can break curses. However, misusing it will leave you with some serious side effects.
"Now then, we're looking for Black Mushrooms today.
You have to heat it really well to detoxify it before you eat it. Okay, Rayas?"
"Ganan... I really want to go back to hunting now. This is so much hassle."
"You idiot, you're doing this on purpose, aren't you?"

A silver lychee fruit. This fruit sparkles like an ornament, and is a great for staying hydrated while crossing the desert. It is also famous as an ingredient for making alcohol. The Reigrad Guild Master drank too much of it once and ended up making a huge disturbance. His daughter, who looks nothing like him, was furious with his disgraceful behaviour, and apparently beat him to within an inch of his life.

The rare Silver Melon. Although it doesn't look edible, it has an exquisite flavour. At one point, the second in command of the Magus Empire of La Riiz's 3rd Magus Division told the leader of another division, who was persistently trying to hit on her, to "Bring me a Silver Melon.", thinking it was an impossible task, but the leader actually came back with one. No one - not even himself - will say anything about what happened to him afterwards.

Just finding one of these brings good luck, but it is said to bring even more luck to the person who holds it. A new adventurer didn't find one after searching everywhere, but a girl who had lost her memory found one the very same day she started searching.
"Now, Iris. This picture is of a walnut that can't be found easily. It's a Happiness..."
"Is this the one you mean, Rayas?"
"How on Earth...?"

Cheese made with a blue mould. Although it doesn't look very appetizing, it works very well as a pasta sauce, or on top of pizza. People who aren't familiar with the ingredients wouldn't think it's edible though, and as a matter of fact, one new adventurer, when he was helping at Fire Mountaincat, mistook it for mouldy cheese and
threw it out. The owner was furious with him and made him work until he smelled more like cheese than the owner.

This is the most popular cheese in Raktehelm, and is produced in many places. The red colour of this cheese comes from the plant used in its creation…
"Sophie, why is this cheese so red?"
"Well, Rayas… That's because I mix the blood of living things into it."
"I see!"
"Um, you're supposed to question that part."

Everyone loves this holey cheese. It can be used for anything from pizza and pasta, to catching mice.
"Sophie, Rolly's missing. Have you seen him?"
"Welcome, Iris. I'm sure he'll roll along behind me."
"Thank goodness. Where did he go?"
"He was by a mousetrap with some cheese on it."

This cheese is made from milk from the northern part of Bamint. It goes well with red wine and is used in many recipes. It is also known as the "Queen of Cheeses". A girl who runs an alchemist in Reigrad, in the Isliid Empire, loves melting Camembert Cheese over vegetables and bread to make "Camembert Fondue". She uses her own alchemical cauldron to do it, apparently.

This hard, blue cheese has blue mould penetrating to its very core. The blue mould gives a sharp edge to its taste. The name Gorgonzola comes from "Gorgonius", the name of the explorer who discovered it, and "Zora", the name of the cave he discovered it in. In Fire Mountaincat, to avoid it being thrown away by overzealous adventurers, only the owner knows where this cheese is stored.

Dyed red like the passion of your heart I was mistaken watching you When you embraced me quietly You welcomed me with a passion beyond imagination This is "love" beyond passion! Ah… I want to keep accepting your love Even if it scorches this body of mine-The Cuisine Poet, Clampshire. "Red Lover"

The No.1 food causing loss of appetite. Although the nuance and phrasing is slightly different in Raktehelm, the idea that this food is "To be given to people who need to lose weight." is common across all of Raktehelm. In stark contrast to its appearance, it actually tastes quite nice. Incidentally, a certain second in command, Rose Garden said to "**censored**" in order to "**censored**"".

Although it looks very spicy, it actually tastes quite mild. Even small children can eat it. In Reigrad, many people don't eat it because it has a reputation for being too mild. Giving someone the enemy of parents, a "Trick Yellow Curry", to someone who doesn't like spices after they order a "Mild Yellow Curry" is a popular prank now.

A very toxic-looking curry. Its taste is somewhat unexpected. It alternates from bitter to sweet and back again. This curry is called "Taste Pandora", and is disliked by everyone apart from a few odd-ball houses. In the past, a noblewoman believed that no one would think to poison such a dish, and dug into it. She died from a poison in the curry...

This curry's black and gooey appearance led to it getting nicknames such as "Dark Fire", "Dark Matter", and "Unidentified Alchemical Failure". It doesn't taste at all bad, but it isn't very popular because of how it looks. The biggest reason people don't like it though, is because if you eat it, the inside of your mouth turns pitch black. Some women never open their mouths during the day for this reason.

This macaron is made from the plentiful strawberries growing in the grasslands. They taste so good that a girl and a mysterious creature start talking to another.
"Myu!"
"No, you can't have it."
"Myu-myu..."
"...Alright, just a little then."
"Myumyumyu♪"
"I don't think you'd mind a little less, actually."

"You think Macarons are just for the women and girls in Raktehelm, don't you? Young men don't understand anything... Not the elegant taste of a sweet that utilizes the full fragrance of coffee beans. It's not too bitter, nor too sweet. This Macaron is the gentleman's sweet." , declares a 65 year old from Famelle. This exquisite dish perfectly balances the bitterness of the coffee beans produced in the north western part of Famelle and the sweetness of the cream.

This Macaron uses thick pieces of fine quality mandarins. As you eat, the gentle sweetness of the fruit spreads throughout your mouth. The Gramenia Republic's Chief of Staff apparently tried them when working in a small town in the northern part of the country, where they have a special heating device called a "Kotatsu". They did attempt to use unripened mandarins, but gave up because they were too sour.

Sweet grapes with plenty of cream and dough. In the Isliid Empire's Capital, fresh grapes are delivered from the vineyards every day while they are in season. The capital is famous for its many shops selling Grape Macarons, and the competition continues day and night. Because of this, many things have been improved upon, and the shops listed in the tourism guidebook, "Rakshuran" have never-ending lines.

A shining silver Macaron. It looks as if it's made of pure silver, but it is indeed a sweet. It is made using silver fruits, such as Silver Melon and Silver Lychee, but if the measurements of the ingredients are even slightly wrong, it won't keep its beautiful silver colour. According to the tourism guidebook, "Rakshuran", the only shop capable of making Silver Macarons is Fire Mountaincat in Reigrad, in the Isliid Empire.

Rice Balls are loved throughout Raktehelm, and everyone has a nostalgic fondness for them. At first glance, they are merely balls of rice, but a lot of care goes into making them, and each region has it's own particular designs. In the Reigrad Adventurer's Guild, Fire Mountaincat provides free Rice Balls, and many of the adventurers (especially the men) look forward to it. There are rumours that the Rice Balls are actually made by the Guild Master, and not Fire Mountaincat, but the truth is a mystery.

Once there was a child who chased after rainbows in the sky after the rain.
That man grew up to become an adventurer and endlessly kept on chasing that rainbow.
He kept walking without giving up, persistently trying to reach the foot of the rainbow.
After several attempts with no success, the adventurer was completely worn out.
It was just then that a drop of rain fell on his head.
As he looked up in disappointment, he saw a beautiful majestic rainbow in the sky.
The adventurer had finally realized,
that there was always a rainbow that watched over him.
