Player EXP 300% UP
※solo or multi
player host only

items.d:
An ancient cuisine in Raktehelm. At the beginning of each year, they make various dishes, pouring their hearts into each one. Fire Mountaincat, where Sophie works has even more customers than is usual this year.
Rayas: "Sophie, would you like a hand?"
Sophie: "There's nothing you can help with."
Ganan: "Haha! Failing at the beginning of the year doesn't bode well for the rest of it!"

The head chef of Reigrad Castle, Lakida created this curry using metal chicken meat. The dish went on to spread Lakida's name, overturning the idea that the meat had no use as a food ingredient. The recipe itself is top secret. Because it cannot be made in large quantities, only a few have had the opportunity to eat this dish, and even in Reigrad, it's a rare sight. It has a slightly sweet and addictive taste.
items.sub:
ATK 10% UP
Break power 5% UP
Unit EXP 100% UP

items.d: Pokke, an apprentice chef at Reigrad Castle was being hounded by new menu design tasks, requested by the head chef. One day, while eating a pre-prepared curry with his head bowed, a mischievous Golcat appeared before him. "Make it shine gold like Gren!", the Golcat said. Encouraged by this advice, Pokke made a luxurious curry using lots of gold gilt. Needless to say, the head chef was furious with him.
items.sub:
HP  10% UP
DEF  10% UP
50% Gren UP

items.d: This is one of the dishes served at Fire Mountaincat. It uses valuable Melmed Bird meat, which can only be found in the forests in the western part of Isliid. The richness of the fatty meat that explodes in the mouth can only described as a "Miracle of Raktehelm". It's a favourite of the Reigrad Guild Master, Ganan, and he asks for it every time he visits the shop. His rippling muscles may be maintained thanks to this dish.
items.sub:
HP 5% UP
ATK,DEF 3% UP
Break Power 2% UP

items.d: A supreme dish combining the excellent flavoring of Dragon Steak and the finest aged meat. A clear cut above regular meats, with such tenderness that it melts in your mouth, unleashing the depth of its flavor. It’s said that the meat goes under a process called “aging” which takes a month to bring out its flavor in full. But as everyone knows, if you were to leave meat out for a month, of course it would rot. How and what exactly this aging process includes, is still yet unknown to the public.

Grown from carefully cultivated soil and specially prepared fertilizer, the vegetables in this salad are beyond compare to those found in the wild in taste and nutrition. This verdant feast is all the rage among health and beauty-conscious women. Even the Third Lady of Bamint asked the owner of the Firecat's Den to teach her how to make it, but she was flatly rejected. "You think I'd let you handle such high-quality ingredients?!"

Soba with sweetened nishin (herring) on top.
The combination of its rich broth that's popular in the Kanto Area and the tender nishin topping makes this a exquisite dish.

This is frozen raw salmon that can only be eaten during the winter months and is made by hanging it from a tree.
Freezing it kills the harmful parasites and simultaneously makes it possible to absorb more vitamins from the meat.
It's so tasty, it just melts in your mouth!"

A 'curry' dish, which is a stew made from a paste with various spices mixed together,
poured over rice. The meat is cooked well and gives the dish a hearty flavor.

Mako Mankanshoku's mother, Sukuyo's best dish which Ryuko Matoi and Mako love.
Even Satsuki Kiryuin says it's "delicious." It is unknown of what she is actually frying,
but the secret is to chop it up in small pieces and mix it up with potatoes.
items.sub:
Equipment CT 2% DOWN
Skill CT 5% DOWN

items.d: A fine example of wild Nihei-style cuisine made by Nihei Tetsuzo. This flavorful dish is made using brown bear intestines that have been cleaned with snow and then stuffed with blood. It is very nutritious--a perfect meal after a hard day's work.

An otter stew simmered with root vegetables and a variety of seasonings. The fatty otter meat comes apart as it is stewed, bringing out a light sweet flavor. The whole otter head that is boiled together with the stew is considered to be especially delicious.

An extreme curry for those people who can no longer be satisfied by the normal Red Curry. This kind of spicy is no longer a meal, but a weapon. "As lovers of the extreme collapsed one after another, she appeared before me... I recognised her face. I think it was when I visited Reigrad. I think I saw her in the arena... She never broke a sweat, polishing off this dish...!"

The Blue Curry's colour has been polished to an azure lustre, and now feels refreshing, somehow. People order it because it's summertime, and Raktehelm experiences a strange boom. The Isliid Empire's capital wants to join in with this boom, but as expected, too many people are put off by the unappetizing colour. Before long, glasses that make the Blue Curry appear to be normal curry are soon being sold. They also experience an explosive peak in sales.

The Yellow Curry has been reinvented. The recipe was originally designed around the colour of the sauce and keeping the flavour mild. The new Yellow Curry has reached the absolute pinnacle of mildness. We aren't sure if it can even be called a curry anymore. The power of this curry was demonstrated at the annual International Food Competition, held at the Isliid Empire's capital. It was then that the now famous words were uttered: "This curry is sweet!"

The Culprit of the "Purple Curry Murder", which took the life of a noble when she ate a poisoned Purple Curry which her taste tester hadn't first sampled. The Fire Mountaincat's owner was incensed by the face that his food had been used for murder, and caught the assassin himself. The assassin made this statement: "Wow... I didn't think I'd get caught so easily... I should have prepared more traps."

There isn't anything wrong with the taste, but the unique effect of turning the inside of your mouth black has been enhanced even further. Its creators have succeeded in doing what no one has ever done before - extending the effect so that it lasts a whole week now. One man, whose fiance had eaten the Black Curry, was so shocked by her appearance that he broke off their engagement, and my be sued for his mistake. We recommend staying away from people for a while after eating this curry.

When the commander of the Isliid Empire Defence Force was wounded and being treated, I remembered about the Fire Mountaincat owner who I've been friends with for a long time. We improved the curry recipe and gave the commander some. Fast forward to now, and our commander has retired to be a guild master in Reigrad. Even now, he eats this curry, remembering his allies and letting himself smile a little.

These macarons are made from strawberries selected from the best of the bunch. It is said that, because these strawberries have absorbed energy very well, people who eat these macarons will gain vitality from them. In ancient times, macarons have been given as an offering to the gods because of they were made of high quality ingredients. This last macaron my be closer to the original

These macarons are made from the most nutritious of the coffee beans. Demand for these macarons is rising among adventurers and knights, because of coffee's effect which activates the brain and helps you to judge situations more quickly. The candy store in the north western part of Famelle, which is where these coffee beans are produced, only sells these macarons once a month. It's a sacred ground for coffee lovers, who gather here from all over Raktehelm.

A sweet bursting with nutrition, as it uses the whole mandarin, all the way up to the skin. Mandarins have the effect of enhancing bodily functions, and it is said that if you eat them, your body will not break during your adventure. There is a saying in Gramenia which goes "Give sweets made of mandarins to children who travel." Adventurers, knights and travellers all carry them in Gramenia, no matter how strong they are.

A sweet made from high quality ingredients taken from the harvest that year. It has been confirmed to help people recover from fatigue, and is often used a token of sympathy for sick people. In the Principality of Bamint, the second in command of the Royal Knights tried to get approval for their use as combat rations.

A macaron made from rare silver fruit. Its exact properties are unknown, but some who have eaten it report having turns of good fortune, such as being promoted, getting married to a wonderful knight or finding an incredibly rare item during their travels. It was a very rare item to begin with, and it is even harder to find one nowadays.

A special macaron said to have been given to the temple by the previous owner of Fire Mountaincat. The previous owner kept the ingredients and recipe secret from everyone including his beloved daughter, the second owner. She remembered the taste however, and miraculously recreated it. "My dad's cooking was the best, but when I ate that macaron, I couldn't stop the tears from flowing."

The medicinal effects of Red Mushrooms have been made more powerful through selective breeding, but the side effects have also worsened.
"Rayas, the effects of this mushroom pale in comparison to the ones growing over there... Uh, where did she go?"
"...If you're looking for Rayas, she went outside shouting, 'The world is waiting for me!'."
"Iris... Please don't end up like that."

The medicinal effects of Blue Mushrooms have been made more powerful through selective breeding, but the side effects have also worsened.
"...Iris, what happened to Rayas?"
"She was eating mushrooms downstairs a moment ago... But then she suddenly went to her room and hasn't come out. She was mumbling something to herself, too..."
"There's nothing we can do once she gets like that... She won't come out until the effects wear off."

The medicinal effects of Yellow Mushrooms have been made more powerful through selective breeding, but the side effects have also worsened.
"..."
"Ganan! Please teach me about mushrooms today, as well! Anything for raw mushrooms!"
"...Ganan."
"Don't say anything... Iris, we'll lose if we charge into this blindly."

The medicinal effects of Purple Mushrooms have been made more powerful through selective breeding, but the side effects have also worsened.
"Oooaaahhh!"
"Oww! What did you do that for, Ganan? I hadn't even eaten it yet! What a waste of a mushroom..."
"You shouldn't be trying to eat it! I knew you were doing this on purpose!"

The medicinal effects of Black Mushrooms have been made more powerful through selective breeding, but the side effects have also worsened.
"Iris, where did that idiot go?"
"...She went out. She said, 'I'm fed up of always studying mushrooms. I'm gonna find another guild master to teach me."
"..."
"Ganan... You look even scarier than usual right now."

There is a special variety of Silver Lychee, called the "Witch Species", which is cultivated in the southern part of the Magus Empire of La Riiz. Processing it into drinking water makes it possible to make a long journey across the desert with only a little water. Processing it into sweets makes them taste superb, and processing it into alcohol makes an excellent offering for the gods. Its rarity makes it value immeasurable, since it grows in the middle of a remote den of monsters. It has been sought after by men in every age.

This variety of Silver Melon has been engineered to improve its properties. It has been reported that silver-luminescent ingredients have a positive effect on the cognitive functions of the brain, and we hope to supply universities and other educational institutions with it eventually, but due to the high price, it is currently only available to knights and nobles. At the moment, only high ranking officials can afford to eat it, and it is never usually seen in normal markets. Even if it was, the insane price would prevent anyone from buying it.

"Red Cheese that has matured for far longer than regular Red Cheese. This cheese, which craftsmen have poured their time and skills into making has a smooth, deep flavour. The beautiful red colour is so like the red of the sun dipping over the horizon at sunset... Letting it melt in your mouth releases an aroma that reminds one of the ocean back home."
Gregorous, Gourmet, from the "Homesickness in the Roar of the Ocean"

Rare Blue Cheese matured in a cave, under specific conditions with raw milk purchased from a designated farm. Its grotesque appearance has not improved, but its flavour and saltiness have improved greatly. "The mould that produces that smell... reminds me of an adventure book that I spent most of my childhood reading."
Gregorous, Gourmet, from "Mellow Wings"

"This Emmental Cheese has holes the size of walnuts, indicating the degree of maturation. For Emmental, holes the size of walnuts show it to be in best condition. They are neither too large nor too small. "Those wide eyes reminded me of my girlfriend when I was a child..."
Gregorous, Gourmet, from "Abyss of the Eye"

The maturation of this cheese was halted precisely before it reached core of the cheese. It is at its most flavoursome in this state, and can fetch a high price. "The hard core that remains is exposed to fire and watching it melt away, I am reminded of when I was a young man, and I find myself likening myself to it... It was not a deeply held belief of mine, but rather a stinky dream."
Gregorous, Gourmet, from "Purity of Innocence"

"The origin of Gorgonzola Cheese is said to have started the molded cheese revolution, when adventurers travelling to Raktehelm before the great war left some cheese in a cave and returned for it later. "A desolate mountain range. When I think of them waiting here for so long that their minds started to shut down, I cannot remain calm."
Gregorous, Gourmet, from "One Man's Survival"

This cheese was created by blending many other cheeses. It is designed to be carried by people in dangerous occupations, such as adventurers and knights. It will stay fresh even in poor conditions and is highly nutritious. It's the perfect cheese for an adventurer. "Cut it, melt it, mold it into a shape... It's almost exactly like a young person..."
Gregorous, Gourmet, from "The Thickness of Skin"

An otter stew simmered with root vegetables and a variety of seasonings. The fatty otter meat comes apart as it is stewed, bringing out a light sweet flavor. The whole otter head that is boiled together with the stew is considered to be especially delicious.

This refined treat offers the fragrance of coffee beans grown in northwest Famelle balanced with rich cream. Neither too sweet nor too bitter, it has become hugely popular throughout Raktehelm since its recent invention.

items.d: A special variety of macaron sold only once a month in limited quantities. The coffee stimulates the brain for faster decision-making, making it hotly demanded among adventurers and knights.

Charred Bits. It's black and charred. What more is there to say? But don't hate it for being charred. These Charred Bits are wanted by many farmers throughout Raktehelm to use as fertilizer... However, it's not particularly useful for an adventurer. Some people gather Charred Bits to make their own fertilizer, and sell it all off to make a living. They say, "It's most profitable when new people come to the Guild in each region.

items.d: This intensely odorous lump is the end result of Charred Bits that have decomposed. As the decomposition progresses, it can't even be used as fertilizer anymore. People avoid you just for carrying it. You really should bury it somewhere. Previously, when there was a commotion because of a hellish smell at Fire Mountaincat, the owner discovered the cause to be a pile of Decomposed Charred Bits that some new adventurers had been hoarding.
